info.title: Cribl API Reference

eventBreakerRegex.title: Event Breaker
eventBreakerRegex.description: The regex used to break the stream into events at the beginning of the match. Matched content will be consumed, unless you use a lookahead regex such as (?=pattern) to keep it. Do NOT use capturing groups in the pattern.

jsonArrayField.title: Array field
jsonArrayField.description: The path to an array in a JSON event with records to extract, such as Records or level1.level2.events. Leave blank if result itself is an array, such as [{...},{...}]

parentFieldsToCopy.title: Parent fields to copy
parentFieldsToCopy.description: Top-level fields to copy to the output events. Nested fields are not supported. 'Array field' is always excluded. If 'Array field' points to a nested array, the entire top-level object will be excluded. Supports * wildcards. Enclose field names containing special characters in single or double quotes.

jsonExtractAll.title: JSON extract fields
jsonExtractAll.description: Automatically extract fields from JSON events. When disabled, only _raw and _time are defined on extracted events.

fieldsToRemove.title: Fields to remove
fieldsToRemove.description: List of fields to remove from the output events. Supports * wildcards. Enclose field names containing special characters in single or double quotes.

jsonTimeField.title: Timestamp field
jsonTimeField.description: Optional path to timestamp field in extracted events, such as eventTime or level1.level2.eventTime.

fieldsLineRegex.title: Fields regex
fieldsLineRegex.description: Regex with one capturing group that captures all fields (and delimiters) to be broken by field delimiter

headerLineRegex.title: Header line
headerLineRegex.description: Regex matching a file header line

nullFieldVal.title: Null value
nullFieldVal.description: Representation of a null value. Null fields are not added to events.

cleanFields.title: Clean fields
cleanFields.description: Clean field names by replacing non [a-zA-Z0-9] characters with _

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Delimiter character to use to split values

quoteChar.title: Quote char
quoteChar.description: Character used to quote literal values

escapeChar.title: Escape char
escapeChar.description: Character used to escape the quote character in field values

timeField.title: Timestamp field
timeField.description: Optional timestamp field name in extracted events

maxEventBytes.title: Event byte limit
maxEventBytes.description: The maximum number of bytes that an event can be before being flushed to the Pipelines

timestampAnchorRegex.title: Timestamp anchor
timestampAnchorRegex.description: Regex to match before attempting timestamp extraction. Use $ (end of string anchor) to not perform extraction.

timestampTimezone.title: Default timezone
timestampTimezone.description: Timezone to assign to timestamps without timezone info

timestampEarliest.title: Earliest timestamp allowed
timestampEarliest.description: The earliest timestamp value allowed relative to now, such as -42years. Parsed values prior to this date will be set to current time.

timestampLatest.title: Future timestamp allowed
timestampLatest.description: The latest timestamp value allowed relative to now, such as +42days. Parsed values after this date will be set to current time.

digits.title: Digits
digits.description: Number of digits after the decimal point, between 0 and 20. If left blank, defaults to 2.

url.title: Redis URL
url.description: Redis URL to connect to. Format: redis[s]://[[user][:password@]][host][:port][/db-number][?db=db-number[&password=bar[&option=value]]]. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`

rootNodes.title: Root nodes
rootNodes.description: Root nodes to which the cluster connection should be initiated

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: Use TLS for connections to this cluster

rootNodes.title: Sentinels
rootNodes.description: List of sentinels to be used

host.title: Hostname
host.description: Hostname of sentinel node. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: Use TLS for connections to this cluster

credentialsSecret.title: User secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret that references Redis username and password

textSecret.title: Admin secret
textSecret.description: Secret that references Redis admin password

fieldFilterExpr.description: Expression evaluated against {index, name, value} context. Return truthy to keep a field, or falsy to remove it.

regex.description: Regex literal with named capturing groups, such as (?<foo>bar), or _NAME_ and _VALUE_ capturing groups, such as(?<_NAME_0>[^ =]+)=(?<_VALUE_0>[^,]+)

iterations.title: Max exec
iterations.description: The maximum number of times to apply regex to source field when the global flag is set, or when using _NAME_ and _VALUE_ capturing groups

fieldNameExpression.title: Field name format expression
fieldNameExpression.description: JavaScript expression to format field names when _NAME_n and _VALUE_n capturing groups are used. Original field name is in global variable 'name'. Example: To append XX to all field names, use `${name}_XX` (backticks are literal). If empty, names will be sanitized using this regex: /^[_0-9]+|[^a-zA-Z0-9_]+/g. You can access other fields values via __e.<fieldName>.

overwrite.title: Overwrite existing fields
overwrite.description: Overwrite existing event fields with extracted values. If disabled, existing fields will be converted to an array.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Grok pattern to extract fields. Syntax supported: %{PATTERN_NAME:FIELD_NAME}

fields.title: Fields to serialize
fields.description: Required for CSV, ELFF, and CLF. All other formats support wildcard field lists. Examples: host, myField, !source *

pairDelimiter.title: Pair delimiter
pairDelimiter.description: Delimiter used to separate key=value pairs. Defaults to a single space character. Should not have common characters with key-value delimiter.

keyValueDelimiter.title: Key-Value delimiter
keyValueDelimiter.description: Delimiter used to separate key and value in pair. Defaults to a '='. Should not have common characters with pair delimiter.

delimChar.description: Delimiter character to use to split values. If left blank, will default to ','.

quoteChar.title: Quote char
quoteChar.description: Character used to quote literal values. If left blank, will default to '"'.

escapeChar.title: Escape char
escapeChar.description: Escape character used to escape delimiter or quote character. If left blank, will default to the Quote char.

nullValue.title: Null value
nullValue.description: Field value representing the null value. Null fields will be omitted.

passthrough.title: Passthrough mode
passthrough.description: Pass through the original events along with the aggregation events

preserveGroupBys.title: Preserve group by fields
preserveGroupBys.description: Preserve the structure of the original aggregation event's groupby fields

sufficientStatsOnly.title: Sufficient stats mode
sufficientStatsOnly.description: Output only statistics that are sufficient for the supplied aggregations

prefix.title: Output prefix
prefix.description: A prefix that is prepended to all of the fields output by this Aggregations Function

timeWindow.title: Time window
timeWindow.description: The time span of the tumbling window for aggregating events. Must be a valid time string (such as 10s).

aggregations.title: Aggregates
aggregations.description: Combination of Aggregation function and output metric type

agg.title: Aggregation
agg.description: Aggregate function to perform on events. Example: sum(bytes).where(action=='REJECT').as(TotalBytes)

groupbys.title: Group by dimensions
groupbys.description: Optional: One or more dimensions to group aggregates by. Supports wildcard expressions. Wrap dimension names in quotes if using literal identifiers, such as 'service.name'. Warning: Using wildcard '*' causes all dimensions in the event to be included, which can result in high cardinality and increased memory usage. Exclude dimensions that can result in high cardinality before using wildcards. Example: !_time, !_numericValue, *

flushEventLimit.title: Aggregation event limit
flushEventLimit.description: The maximum number of events to include in any given aggregation event

flushMemLimit.title: Aggregation memory limit
flushMemLimit.description: The memory usage limit to impose upon aggregations. Defaults to 80% of the process memory; value configured above default limit is ignored. Accepts numerals with units like KB and MB (example: 128MB).

cumulative.title: Cumulative aggregations
cumulative.description: Enable to retain aggregations for cumulative aggregations when flushing out an aggregation table event. When disabled (the default), aggregations are reset to 0 on flush.

shouldTreatDotsAsLiterals.title: Treat dots as literals
shouldTreatDotsAsLiterals.description: Treat dots in dimension names as literals. This is useful for top-level dimensions that contain dots, such as 'service.name'.

add.description: Set of key-value pairs to evaluate and add/set

value.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value (can be constant)

flushOnInputClose.title: Flush on stream close
flushOnInputClose.description: Flush aggregations when an input stream is closed. If disabled, Time Window Settings control flush behavior.

lagTolerance.title: Lag tolerance
lagTolerance.description: The tumbling window tolerance to late events. Must be a valid time string (such as 10s).

idleTimeLimit.title: Idle bucket time limit
idleTimeLimit.description: How long to wait before flushing a bucket that has not received events. Must be a valid time string (such as 10s).

metricsMode.description: Enable to output the aggregates as metrics. When disabled, aggregates are output as events.

defaultTimezone.title: Default timezone
defaultTimezone.description: Timezone to assign to timestamps without timezone info

timeExpression.title: Time expression
timeExpression.description: Expression to use to format time. Current time, as a JavaScript Date object, is in global `time`. You can access other fields' values via __e.<fieldName>.

offset.title: Start scan offset

maxLen.title: Max timestamp scan depth

defaultTime.title: Default time
defaultTime.description: How to set the time field if no timestamp is found

latestDateAllowed.title: Future timestamp allowed
latestDateAllowed.description: The latest timestamp value allowed relative to now, such as +42days. Parsed values after this date will be set to the Default time.

earliestDateAllowed.title: Earliest timestamp allowed
earliestDateAllowed.description: The earliest timestamp value allowed relative to now, such as -42years. Parsed values prior to this date will be set to the Default time.

timestamps.title: Additional timestamps
timestamps.description: Add regex/strptime pairs to extract additional timestamp formats

regex.title: Regex
regex.description: Regex with first capturing group matching the timestamp

strptime.title: Strptime format
strptime.description: Select or enter strptime format for the captured timestamp

outputField.description: The field to which the CEF formatted event will be output

clones.description: Create clones with the following fields set

items.description: Key-value pairs to set or overwrite in the clone

code.title: Code
code.description: Caution: This Function will be evaluated in an unprotected context. This means that you will be able to execute almost any JavaScript code.

maxNumOfIterations.title: Iteration limit
maxNumOfIterations.description: The maximum number of allowed iterations within this Function. Defaults to 5,000.

activeLogSampleRate.title: Error log sample rate
activeLogSampleRate.description: Rate at which this Function logs errors. For example, a value of 1 logs every error, a value of 1000 (the default) logs every thousandth error, and so on.

useUniqueLogChannel.title: Use unique log channel
useUniqueLogChannel.description: Logs from this Function will be sent to a unique channel in the form `func:code:${pipelineName}:${functionIndex}`. Disable to use the generic `func:code` log channel instead.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Optional, short description of this Function's purpose in the Pipeline

groupBy.title: Grouping properties
groupBy.description: Defines the properties that are concatenated to produce distinct key

isFederated.description: indicator that the operator runs on a federated executor

suppressPreviews.title: Suppress preview results
suppressPreviews.description: Toggle this on to suppress generating previews of intermediate results

dnsLookupFields.title: DNS lookup fields
dnsLookupFields.description: List of field names on which to perform DNS lookup

resourceRecordType.title: Resource record type
resourceRecordType.description: The DNS record type (RR) to return. Defaults to 'A'.

outFieldName.title: Output field name
outFieldName.description: Name of field to add lookup results to. Leave blank to overwrite the lookup field.

reverseLookupFields.title: Reverse DNS lookup fields
reverseLookupFields.description: List of field names on which to perform reverse DNS lookup

inFieldName.title: Lookup field name
inFieldName.description: Name of the field containing the IP to look up. If the field value is not in IPv4 or IPv6 format, the lookup is skipped.

outFieldName.title: Output field name
outFieldName.description: Name of field to add the resolved domain to. Leave blank to overwrite the lookup field.

dnsServers.title: DNS server overrides
dnsServers.description: IPs, in RFC 5952 format, of the DNS servers to use for resolution. Examples: IPv4 1.1.1.1, 4.2.2.2:53, or IPv6 [2001:4860:4860::8888], [2001:4860:4860::8888]:1053. If not specified, system's DNS will be used.

cacheTTL.title: Cache time to live (minutes)
cacheTTL.description: How frequently to expire and refetch DNS cache. Use 0 to disable.

maxCacheSize.title: Cache size limit
maxCacheSize.description: The maximum number of DNS resolutions to be cached locally. Leave at default unless you understand the implications of changing.

useResolvConf.title: Use /etc/resolv.conf
useResolvConf.description: Attempt to resolve DNS short names using the search or domain directive from /etc/resolv.conf

lookupFallback.title: Fall back to DNS.lookup()
lookupFallback.description: If unable to resolve a DNS short name, make a DNS.lookup() call to resolve it. Caution: This might degrade performance in unrelated areas of @{product}.

domainOverrides.title: Use search or domain fallbacks
domainOverrides.description: Specify fallback values for the DNS resolver to use when it cannot resolve a DNS short name

timeWindow.title: Aggregation time window
timeWindow.description: The time span of the tumbling window for aggregating events. Must be a valid time string (such as 10s).

dropDimensions.title: Dimensions to drop
dropDimensions.description: One or more dimensions to be dropped. Supports wildcard expressions. Warning: Using wildcard '*' causes all dimensions in the event to be dropped.

flushOnInputClose.title: Flush on stream close
flushOnInputClose.description: Flush aggregations when an input stream is closed. If disabled, aggregations are flushed based on Time Window Settings instead.

mode.title: Sample mode
mode.description: Defines how sample rate will be derived: log(previousPeriodCount) or sqrt(previousPeriodCount)

keyExpr.title: Sample group key
keyExpr.description: Expression used to derive sample group key. Example:`${domain}:${status}`. Each sample group will have its own derived sampling rate based on volume. Defaults to `${host}`.

samplePeriod.title: Sample period
samplePeriod.description: How often (in seconds) sample rates will be adjusted

minEvents.title: Minimum events
minEvents.description: Minimum number of events that must be received in previous sample period for sampling mode to be applied to current period. If the number of events received for a sample group is less than this minimum, a sample rate of 1:1 is used.

maxSampleRate.title: Sampling rate limit
maxSampleRate.description: Maximum sampling rate. If computed sampling rate is above this value, it will be limited to this value.

add.description: Set of key-value pairs to evaluate and add/set

value.title: Value Expression
value.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value (can be constant)

disabled.description: Set to No to disable the evaluation of an individual expression

keep.title: Keep fields
keep.description: List of fields to keep. Supports * wildcards. Takes precedence over 'Remove fields'.

remove.title: Remove fields
remove.description: List of fields to remove. Supports * wildcards. Fields that match 'Keep fields' will not be removed. Enclose field names containing special characters in single or double quotes.

printUndefineds.title: Print undefined as null
printUndefineds.description: When enabled (e.g. for Cribl Search), convert undefined expression results to null so requested-but-missing fields appear in JSON output. When disabled (default), undefined is preserved.

shouldMarkCriblBreaker.title: Add to cribl_breaker
shouldMarkCriblBreaker.description: Add this Function name to the cribl_breaker field

maxEventBytes.title: Event byte limit
maxEventBytes.description: The maximum number of bytes that an event can be before being flushed to the Pipelines

timestampAnchorRegex.title: Timestamp anchor
timestampAnchorRegex.description: Regex to match before attempting timestamp extraction. Use $ (end of string anchor) to not perform extraction.

timestampTimezone.title: Default timezone
timestampTimezone.description: Timezone to assign to timestamps without timezone info

timestampEarliest.title: Earliest timestamp allowed
timestampEarliest.description: The earliest timestamp value allowed relative to now, such as -42years. Parsed values prior to this date will be set to current time.

timestampLatest.title: Future timestamp allowed
timestampLatest.description: The latest timestamp value allowed relative to now, such as +42days. Parsed values after this date will be set to current time.

aggregations.title: Aggregates
aggregations.description: Aggregate function(s) to perform on events. E.g., sum(bytes).where(action=='REJECT').as(TotalBytes)

groupBys.title: Group by fields
groupBys.description: Fields to group aggregates by, supports wildcard expressions.

maxEvents.title: Maximum number of events
maxEvents.description: Specifies how many events are at max kept in memory to be enriched with aggregations

flushOnInputClose.title: Flush on stream close
flushOnInputClose.description: Determines if aggregations should flush when an input stream is closed. If disabled, time window settings will control flush behavior.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: List of top-level fields to include for flattening. Supports * wildcards, except when used on internal fields. Defaults to empty array, which means all fields.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix string for flattened field names. Defaults to empty.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Number representing the nested levels to consider for flattening. Defaults to 5. Minimum should be 1.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Delimiter to be used for flattening. Defaults to underscore.

deleteOriginal.title: Delete original
deleteOriginal.description: When enabled (default), only the folded keys are kept. When disabled, the original entries are retained alongside the folded keys.

separator.title: Separator string
separator.description: Character or string used to separate key levels to be folded. Defaults to the dot (.) character.

selectionRegExp.title: Selection regular expression
selectionRegExp.description: Optional regular expression to select a subset of the keys to fold.

maxDepth.title: Maximum depth
maxDepth.description: Maximum recursion depth when traversing nested objects. Prevents infinite loops caused by cyclic references. Defaults to 20.

file.title: GeoIP file (.mmdb)
file.description: Select an uploaded Maxmind database, or specify path to a Maxmind database with .mmdb extension

inField.title: IP field
inField.description: Field name in which to find an IP to look up. Can be nested.

outField.title: Result field
outField.description: Field name in which to store the GeoIP lookup results

extraInField.title: IP Field
extraInField.description: Field name in which to find an IP to look up. Can be nested.

extraOutField.title: Result Field
extraOutField.description: Field name in which to store the GeoIP lookup results

outFieldMappings.title: Output field mappings
outFieldMappings.description: Search-specific mappings for granular control over event enrichment

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Grok pattern to extract fields. Syntax supported: %{PATTERN_NAME:FIELD_NAME}

source.title: Source field
source.description: Field on which to perform Grok extractions

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Array of template definitions. Uses event.__template_id to select template at runtime.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description of what this template is used for

type.title: Template type
type.description: Type categorization for the template (e.g., Universal, Email, Slack)

targetField.title: Target field
targetField.description: Field name to store the rendered template result. Defaults to _raw.

parseJson.title: Parse as JSON
parseJson.description: Parse the rendered template as JSON and store as an object instead of a string. Useful for building structured data like Slack blocks.

removeOnNull.title: Remove field if empty
removeOnNull.description: Remove the target field if the rendered result is empty or null.

hints.title: Hint
hints.description: Hints passed to the join function

leftFieldName.title: Left Field Name
leftFieldName.description: The field name to join on, on the left side.

rightFieldName.title: Right Field Name
rightFieldName.description: The field name on the right side of the data, i.e. the stage results, that we are joining with

searchJobId.title: Search Job Id
searchJobId.description: The id for this search job.

stageId.title: Stage Id
stageId.description: The stage we are joining with.

path.title: Path
path.description: Path to array to unroll, such as foo.0.bar

name.title: New name
name.description: Name of each exploded array element in each new event. Leave empty to expand the array element with its original name.

searchJobId.title: Search Job Id
searchJobId.description: Id of the search job this function is running on.

tee.title: Tee
tee.description: Tee results to search. When set to true results will be shipped instead of stats

flushMs.title: Flush period
flushMs.description: How often are stats flushed in ms

suppressPreviews.title: Suppress periodic stats
suppressPreviews.description: Disables generation of intermediate stats. When true stats will be emitted only on end

limit.title: Event limit
limit.description: Number of qualifying events to pass through

ruleset.title: Full ruleset, i.e. for use with live data capture, which uses draft/unsaved rulesets

markAndIncludeDroppedEvents.title: Mark and include dropped events
markAndIncludeDroppedEvents.description: Only for use with live data capture. Mark events that were dropped by dataset rules and still include them for capture

file.title: Lookup file path (.csv, .csv.gz)
file.description: Path to the lookup file. Reference environment variables via $. Example: $HOME/file.csv

dbLookup.title: Use Disk-Based Lookup
dbLookup.description: Enable to use a disk-based lookup. This option displays only the settings relevant to disk-based mode and hides those for in-memory lookups.

matchMode.title: Match mode
matchMode.description: Specifies the matching method based on the format and logic used in the lookup file

matchType.title: Match type
matchType.description: Further defines how to handle multiple matches: return the first match, the most specific match, or all matches

reloadPeriodSec.title: Reload period (sec)
reloadPeriodSec.description: Checks the lookup file periodically for changes and reloads it if modified. Set to -1 to disable reloading (default). Useful for lookups not managed by Stream or not updated by an external process. [Learn more](https://docs.cribl.io/stream/lookup-function/#advanced-settings)

inFields.description: Fields that should be used to key into the lookup table

eventField.title: Lookup Field Name in Event
eventField.description: Field name as it appears in events

lookupField.title: Corresponding Field Name in Lookup
lookupField.description: Optional: The field name as it appears in the lookup file. Defaults to event field name

outFields.title: Output fields
outFields.description: Fields to add to events after matching lookup. Defaults to all if not specified.

lookupField.title: Output Field Name from Lookup
lookupField.description: The field name as it appears in the lookup file

eventField.title: Lookup Field Name in Event
eventField.description: Optional: Field name to add to event. Defaults to lookup field name.

defaultValue.title: Default Value
defaultValue.description: Optional: Value to assign if lookup entry is not found

addToEvent.title: Add to raw event
addToEvent.description: Add the looked-up values to _raw, as key=value pairs

ignoreCase.title: Ignore case
ignoreCase.description: Whether to ignore case when performing lookups using Match Mode: Regex.

matchRegex.title: Match Regex
matchRegex.description: Pattern to replace. Use /g to replace all matches.

replaceExpr.title: Replace Expression
replaceExpr.description: A JavaScript expression or literal to replace the matching content. Capturing groups can be referenced as g1, g2, and so on, and event fields as event.<fieldName>.

disabled.description: Set to No to disable the evaluation of an individual rule

fields.title: Apply to fields
fields.description: Fields on which to apply the masking rules. Supports * wildcards, except when used on internal fields.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Depth to which the Mask Function will search for fields to mask

flags.title: Evaluate fields
flags.description: Fields to evaluate if one or more masking rules are matched

targetNames.title: Target field names
targetNames.description: stores the value as new target field name

rowLimit.title: Row limit
rowLimit.description: max. number of rows generated out of every source events

itemIndexName.title: Item index name
itemIndexName.description: name of an optional index property generated into the output

bagExpansionMode.title: Bag expansion mode
bagExpansionMode.description: decides if bag-values are expanded to bags or arrays

arrayPath.title: Field name of source array
arrayPath.description: Field name of the array within events that contains the data objects of interest. Can be a path.

relativeKeyPath.title: Field name of key
relativeKeyPath.description: Extract the K-V pair's key from this field, relative to the data object.

relativeValuePath.title: Field name of value
relativeValuePath.description: Extract the K-V pair's value from this field, relative to the data object.

targetBagPath.title: Field name for pulled fields
targetBagPath.description: Optionally, specify a bag as the target for K-V entries. If not specified, these entries are stored on each top-level event.

deleteOriginal.title: Delete source array after processing
deleteOriginal.description: Toggle this on to remove each original array of data objects after extraction. If toggled off, arrays are retained.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: List of notification routing policies evaluated in order

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: If true, this policy will be skipped during evaluation

waitToGroup.title: Wait to Group (Minutes)
waitToGroup.description: Time to wait (in minutes) to group similar alerts before sending

groupByLabels.title: Group By Labels
groupByLabels.description: Event fields to use for grouping

conditions.title: OR Conditions
conditions.description: List of conditions. If ANY condition matches (OR), the policy applies. Each condition is a list of tags that must ALL match (AND).

key.title: Field Name
key.description: Event field name to match against

value.title: Value
value.description: Value to compare against (string, number, boolean)

templateTargetPairs.title: Template & Target Pairs
templateTargetPairs.description: List of targets to route to and the templates to use

final.title: Final
final.description: If true, stop evaluating further policies after this one matches

order.title: Order
order.description: Evaluation order of this policy (lower numbers evaluated first)

notificationId.title: Workspace
notificationId.description: Workspace within the deployment to send the search results to.

searchId.title: Search Id
searchId.description: Id of the search this function is running on.

trigger.title: Trigger condition expression
trigger.description: Js expression that filters events, a greater than 'Trigger Count' events will trigger the notification

triggerType.title: Trigger type
triggerType.description: Type of the trigger condition. custom applies a kusto expression over the results, and results count applies a comparison over results count

triggerComparator.title: Count comparator
triggerComparator.description: Operation to be applied over the results count

triggerCount.title: Trigger Count
triggerCount.description: How many results that match trigger the condition

resultsLimit.title: Top number results
resultsLimit.description: Number of results to include in the notification event

message.title: Message content
message.description: Message content template, available fields: searchId, resultSet, savedQueryId, notificationId, searchResultsUrl

authToken.title: Api Auth Token
authToken.description: Auth token for sending notification messages

tenantId.title: Tenant Id
tenantId.description: Current tenant id

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Depth to which the Numerify Function will search within a nested event. Depth greater than 5 (the default) could decrease performance.

ignoreFields.title: Ignore fields
ignoreFields.description: Fields to NOT numerify. Takes precedence over 'Include expression' when set. Supports wildcards. A '!' before field name(s) means: numerify all fields EXCEPT these. For syntax details, see [Wildcard Lists](https://docs.cribl.io/stream/introduction-reference/#wildcard-lists).

items.description: Field to ignore

filterExpr.title: Include expression
filterExpr.description: Optional JavaScript expression to determine whether a field should be numerified. If left blank, all fields will be numerified. Use the 'name' and 'value' global variables to access fields' names/values. Examples: `value != null`, `name=='fieldname'`. You can access other fields' values via `__e.<fieldName>`.

digits.title: Digits
digits.description: Number of digits after the decimal point, between 0 and 20. If left blank, defaults to 2.

batchOTLPLogs.title: Batch OTLP logs
batchOTLPLogs.description: Batch OTLP log records by shared top-level `resource` attributes

sendBatchSize.title: Batch size
sendBatchSize.description: Number of log records after which a batch will be sent, regardless of the timeout

timeout.title: Batch timeout (ms)
timeout.description: Time duration after which a batch will be sent, regardless of size

sendBatchMaxSize.title: Batch size limit (kb)
sendBatchMaxSize.description: Maximum batch size. Enter 0 for no maximum.

metadataKeys.title: Batch log metadata keys
metadataKeys.description: When set, this processor will create one batcher instance per distinct combination of values in the metadata

metadataCardinalityLimit.title: Metadata cardinality limit
metadataCardinalityLimit.description: Limit the number of unique combinations of metadata key values that will be processed over the lifetime of the process. After the limit is reached, events with new metadata key value combinations will be dropped.

resourceAttributePrefixes.title: Resource attribute prefixes
resourceAttributePrefixes.description: The prefixes of top-level attributes to add as resource attributes. Each attribute must match the regex pattern `^[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+$`. Use Eval to copy nested attributes to the top level for matching.

sendBatchSize.description: Number of metric data points after which a batch will be sent, regardless of the timeout

unpackedFields.title: Unpacked fields
unpackedFields.description: List of fields to keep, everything else will be packed

labelField.title: Labeling field
labelField.description: Fields to be used for the left-most column.

dataFields.title: Data fields
dataFields.description: Fields with the cell values (i.e. aggregates)

qualifierFields.title: Qualifier fields
qualifierFields.description: Fields to qualify or group data fields

fields.title: Add metrics
fields.description: List of metrics from event to extract and format. Formatted metrics can be used by a destination to pass metrics to a metrics aggregation platform.

inFieldName.title: Event Field Name
inFieldName.description: The name of the field in the event that contains the metric value

outFieldExpr.title: Metric Name Expression
outFieldExpr.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate the metric field name. Defaults to Event Field Name.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Overwrite previous metric specs. Leave disabled to append.

dimensions.title: Add dimensions
dimensions.description: Optional list of dimensions to include in events. Wildcards supported. If you don't specify metrics, values will be appended to every metric found in the event. When you add a new metric, dimensions will be present only in those new metrics.

removeMetrics.title: Remove metrics
removeMetrics.description: Optional list of metric field names to look for when removing metrics. When a metric's field name matches an element in this list, the metric will be removed from the event.

removeDimensions.title: Remove dimensions
removeDimensions.description: Optional list of dimensions to remove from every metric found in the event. Wildcards supported.

outField.title: Result field
outField.description: Name of the field in which to store the returned value. Leave blank to discard returned value.

command.title: Command
command.description: Redis command to perform. For a complete list visit: https://redis.io/commands

keyExpr.title: Key
keyExpr.description: A JavaScript expression to compute the value of the key to operate on. Can also be a constant such as 'username'.

argsExpr.title: Args
argsExpr.description: A JavaScript expression to compute arguments to the operation. Can return an array.

deploymentType.title: Deployment type
deploymentType.description: How the Redis server is configured. Defaults to Standalone

maxBlockSecs.title: Blocking time limit
maxBlockSecs.description: Maximum amount of time (seconds) to wait before assuming that Redis is down and passing events through. Use 0 to disable.

enableClientSideCaching.title: Client-side cache
enableClientSideCaching.description: Enable client-side cache. Redundant when using Redis write operations. See more options at Settings > General > Limits > Redis Cache.

url.title: Redis URL
url.description: Redis URL to connect to. Format: redis[s]://[[user][:password@]][host][:port][/db-number][?db=db-number[&password=bar[&option=value]]]. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`

rootNodes.title: Root nodes
rootNodes.description: Root nodes to which the cluster connection should be initiated

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: Use TLS for connections to this cluster

credentialsSecret.title: User secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret that references Redis username and password

textSecret.title: Admin secret
textSecret.description: Secret that references Redis admin password

regex.title: Regex
regex.description: Regex literal with named capturing groups, such as (?<foo>bar), or _NAME_ and _VALUE_ capturing groups, such as (?<_NAME_0>[^ =]+)=(?<_VALUE_0>[^,]+)

source.title: Source field
source.description: Field on which to perform regex field extraction

iterations.title: Max exec
iterations.description: The maximum number of times to apply regex to source field when the global flag is set, or when using _NAME_ and _VALUE_ capturing groups

fieldNameExpression.title: Field name format expression
fieldNameExpression.description: JavaScript expression to format field names when _NAME_n and _VALUE_n capturing groups are used. Original field name is in global variable 'name'. Example: To append XX to all field names, use `${name}_XX` (backticks are literal). If empty, names will be sanitized using this regex: /^[_0-9]+|[^a-zA-Z0-9_]+/g. You can access other fields values via __e.<fieldName>.

overwrite.title: Overwrite existing fields
overwrite.description: Overwrite existing event fields with extracted values. If disabled, existing fields will be converted to an array.

field.title: Field
field.description: Name of the field to apply the regex on (defaults to _raw)

baseFields.title: Parent fields
baseFields.description: Fields whose children will inherit the Rename fields and Rename expression operations. Supports wildcards. If empty, only top-level fields will be renamed.

rename.title: Rename fields
rename.description: Set of key-value pairs to rename fields, where key is the current name and value is the new name. Does not support internal fields.

currentName.title: Current Name
currentName.description: Name of the field to rename. Literal identifiers must be quoted.

newName.title: New Name
newName.description: The name the field will be renamed to. Literal identifiers must be quoted.

renameExpr.title: Rename expression
renameExpr.description: Optional JavaScript expression whose returned value will be used to rename fields. Use the 'name' and 'value' global variables to access field names/values. Example: `name.startsWith('data') ? name.toUpperCase() : name`. You can access other field values via __e.<fieldName>.

wildcardDepth.title: Parent field wildcard depth
wildcardDepth.description: For wildcards specified in Parent fields, sets the maximum depth within events to match and rename fields. Enter `0` to match only top-level fields. Defaults to `5` levels down.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: List of dimensions across which to perform rollups. Supports wildcards. Defaults to all original dimensions.

timeWindow.title: Time window
timeWindow.description: The time span of the rollup window. Must be a valid time string (such as 10s).

gaugeRollup.title: Gauge update
gaugeRollup.description: The operation to use when rolling up gauge metrics. Defaults to last.

rules.title: Sampling rules
rules.description: Events matching these rules will be sampled at the given rate

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: JavaScript filter expression matching events to be sampled. Use true to match all.

rate.title: Sampling Rate
rate.description: Sampling rate; picks one out of N matching events

searchJobId.title: Search Job Id
searchJobId.description: Id of the search job this function is running on.

tee.title: Tee
tee.description: Tee results to search. When set to true results will be shipped instead of stats

flushMs.title: Flush period
flushMs.description: How often are stats flushed in ms

suppressPreviews.title: Suppress periodic stats
suppressPreviews.description: Disables generation of intermediate stats. When true stats will be emitted only on end

url.title: URL
url.description: Full URL to send search to.

group.title: Group
group.description: Group within the workspace we're sending to.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace within the deployment to send the search results to.

sendUrlTemplate.title: URL Template
sendUrlTemplate.description: Template to build the URL to send from.

searchId.title: Search Id
searchId.description: Id of the search this function is running on.

tee.title: Tee
tee.description: Tee results to search. When set to true results will be shipped instead of stats

flushMs.title: Flush period
flushMs.description: How often are stats flushed in ms

suppressPreviews.title: Suppress periodic stats
suppressPreviews.description: Disables generation of intermediate stats. When true stats will be emitted only on end

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: In Sender mode, forwards search results directly to the destination. In Metrics mode, accumulates metrics from federated send operators, and forwards the aggregate metrics.

rulesetId.title: Ruleset ID
rulesetId.description: The ID of the ruleset to use for the scan

replaceExpr.title: Mitigation Expression
replaceExpr.description: A JavaScript expression or literal to replace the matching content. Capturing groups can be referenced as g1, g2, and so on, and event fields as event.<fieldName>.

fields.title: Apply to fields
fields.description: Rulesets act on the events contained in these fields. Mitigation expressions apply to the scan results. Supports wildcards (*).

excludeFields.title: Fields to ignore
excludeFields.description: Fields that the mitigation expression will not be applied to. Supports wildcards (*).

flags.title: Add fields
flags.description: Fields to add when mitigation is applied to an event

includeDetectedRules.title: Include detected rules
includeDetectedRules.description: Add matching ruleset IDs to a field called "__detected"

mode.title: Operation mode
mode.description: Extract creates new fields. Reserialize extracts and filters fields, and then reserializes.

srcField.title: Source field
srcField.description: Field containing text to be parsed

dstField.title: Destination field
dstField.description: Name of the field to add fields to. Extract mode only.

keep.title: Fields to keep
keep.description: List of fields to keep. Supports wildcards (*). Takes precedence over 'Fields to remove'.

remove.title: Fields to remove
remove.description: List of fields to remove. Supports wildcards (*). Cannot remove fields that match 'Fields to keep'.

fieldFilterExpr.title: Fields filter expression
fieldFilterExpr.description: Expression evaluated against {index, name, value} context. Return truthy to keep a field, or falsy to remove it.

allowedKeyChars.title: Allowed key characters
allowedKeyChars.description: A list of characters that may be present in a key name, even though they are normally separator or control characters

allowedValueChars.title: Allowed value characters
allowedValueChars.description: A list of characters that may be present in a value, even though they are normally separator or control characters

fields.title: List of fields
fields.description: The fields to be extracted, listed in order. Will auto-generate if empty.

regex.title: Regex
regex.description: Regex literal with named capturing groups, such as (?<foo>bar), or _NAME_ and _VALUE_ capturing groups, such as(?<_NAME_0>[^ =]+)=(?<_VALUE_0>[^,]+)

iterations.title: Max exec
iterations.description: The maximum number of times to apply regex to source field when the global flag is set, or when using _NAME_ and _VALUE_ capturing groups

fieldNameExpression.title: Field name format expression
fieldNameExpression.description: JavaScript expression to format field names when _NAME_n and _VALUE_n capturing groups are used. Original field name is in global variable 'name'. Example: To append XX to all field names, use `${name}_XX` (backticks are literal). If empty, names will be sanitized using this regex: /^[_0-9]+|[^a-zA-Z0-9_]+/g. You can access other fields values via __e.<fieldName>.

overwrite.title: Overwrite existing fields
overwrite.description: Overwrite existing event fields with extracted values. If disabled, existing fields will be converted to an array.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Grok pattern to extract fields. Syntax supported: %{PATTERN_NAME:FIELD_NAME}

fields.title: Fields to serialize
fields.description: Required for CSV, ELFF, CLF, and Delimited values. All other formats support wildcard field lists. Examples: host, array*, !host *

srcField.title: Source field
srcField.description: Field containing object to serialize. Leave blank to serialize top-level event fields.

cleanFields.title: Clean fields
cleanFields.description: Clean field names by replacing non-[a-zA-Z0-9] characters with _

pairDelimiter.title: Pair delimiter
pairDelimiter.description: Delimiter used to separate key=value pairs. Defaults to a single space character. Should not have common characters with key-value delimiter.

keyValueDelimiter.title: Key-Value delimiter
keyValueDelimiter.description: Delimiter used to separate key and value in pair. Defaults to a '='. Should not have common characters with pair delimiter.

fields.title: Lookup fields
fields.description: Set of expressions matched to lookup responses

expr.title: Value Expression
expr.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value (can be constant)

disabled.description: Set to No to disable the evaluation of an individual expression

signals.title: Signal event types to filter
signals.description: List of signal event types to filter

strict.title: Enforce required fields
strict.description: Prevent event serialization if any required fields are missing. When disabled, @{product} will attempt to serialize the event even if required fields are missing, which could cause unexpected behavior at the downstream receiver.

dropFailedEvents.title: Drop failed events
dropFailedEvents.description: When disabled, `snmpSerializeErrors` will be set on the event, and the `__snmpRaw` field will be removed to prevent @{product} from sending the event from the SNMP Trap Destination

sortId.title: Identifier for the specific sort operation
sortId.description: Has to be unique if there are multiple sorts on the pipeline.

comparisonExpression.title: Expression to compare two events
comparisonExpression.description: The expression can access the events via the 'left' and 'right' properties.

topN.title: The amount of events to return sorted
topN.description: Limits the output to N (highest/lowest) events

maxEvents.title: The maximum number of events in input
maxEvents.description: Specifies the number of events that can flow into this function

suppressPreviews.title: Disable intermediate results
suppressPreviews.description: Toggle this on to suppress generating previews of intermediate results

type.title: Output type
type.description: The type of knowledge object, generated by the function (i.e., 'lookup')

destination.title: Configuration for store destination
destination.description: Configures where and how the data should be stored

fieldMapping.title: Mapping of field names
fieldMapping.description: Mapping event property names to output field names

separator.title: Separator for CSV output
separator.description: Character to be used as value delimiter in output

overwrite.title: Overwrite destination
overwrite.description: For existing files, an error is thrown if overwrite is false or the file is replaced if overwrite is true

compress.title: Compress the output
compress.description: True will compress output, false leaves it as it is and auto decides based on size

tee.title: Tee Results
tee.description: Tee results to the next operator

maxEvents.title: Maximum number of events
maxEvents.description: Limits how many events can be stored

suppressPreviews.title: Suppress previews
suppressPreviews.description: Suppresses the timer-based export stats generating

keyExpr.title: Key expression
keyExpr.description: Suppression key expression used to uniquely identify events to suppress. For example, `${ip}:${port}` will use fields ip and port from each event to generate the key.

allow.title: Number to allow
allow.description: The number of events to allow per time period

suppressPeriodSec.title: Suppression period (sec)
suppressPeriodSec.description: The number of seconds to suppress events after 'Number to allow' events are received

dropEventsMode.title: Drop suppressed events
dropEventsMode.description: If disabled, suppressed events will be tagged with suppress=1 but not dropped

maxCacheSize.title: Cache size limit
maxCacheSize.description: The maximum number of keys that can be cached before idle entries are removed. Leave at default unless you understand the implications of changing.

cacheIdleTimeoutPeriods.title: Suppression period timeout
cacheIdleTimeoutPeriods.description: The number of suppression periods 'Suppression Period' of inactivity before a cache entry is considered idle. Leave at default unless you understand the implications of changing.

numEventsIdleTimeoutTrigger.title: Num events to trigger cache clean-up
numEventsIdleTimeoutTrigger.description: Check cache for idle sessions every N events when cache size is > 'Maximum Cache Size'. Leave at default unless you understand the implications of changing.

command.title: Command
command.description: Command to execute and feed events to, via stdin. One JSON-formatted event per line.

restartOnExit.title: Restart on exit
restartOnExit.description: Restart the process if it exits and/or we fail to write to it

env.title: Environment variables
env.description: Environment variables to overwrite or set

field.title: Field name
field.description: Name of field in which to save the timestamp. (If empty, timestamp will not be saved to a field.)

searchJobId.title: Search Job Id
searchJobId.description: The id for this search job.

stageIds.title: Stage Ids
stageIds.description: The stages we are unioning with.

srcExpr.title: Source field expression
srcExpr.description: Field in which to find/calculate the array to unroll. Example: _raw, _raw.split(/\n/)

dstField.title: Destination field
dstField.description: Field in destination event in which to place the unrolled value

eventWindowId.title: Unique Identifier
eventWindowId.description: Identifies the unique ID, used for a event window

registeredFunctions.title: Registered Window Functions
registeredFunctions.description: All window functions, tracked by this event window

tailEventCount.title: Tail Event Count
tailEventCount.description: Number of events to keep before the current event in the window

headEventCount.title: Head Event Count
headEventCount.description: Number of events to keep after the current event in the window

unroll.title: Unroll elements regex
unroll.description: Path to array to unroll. Example: ^root\.child\.ElementToUnroll$

inherit.title: Copy elements regex
inherit.description: Regex matching elements to copy into each unrolled event. Example: ^root\.(childA|childB|childC)$

unrollIdxField.title: Unroll index field
unrollIdxField.description: Add a field with this name, containing the index at which the item was located, starting from 0

authType.description: Enter authentication data directly, or select a secret referencing your auth data

containerName.title: Container name
containerName.description: Container to collect from. This value can be a constant, or a JavaScript expression that can only be evaluated at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}

path.title: Path
path.description: The directory from which to collect data. Templating is supported, such as myDir/${datacenter}/${host}/${app}/. Time-based tokens are supported, such as myOtherDir/${_time:%Y}/${_time:%m}/${_time:%d}/.

extractors.title: Path extractors

key.title: Token
key.description: A token from the template path, such as epoch

expression.title: Extractor Expression
expression.description: A JavaScript expression that accesses a corresponding <token> through the value variable and evaluates the token to populate event fields. Example: {date: new Date(+value*1000)}

extractors.description: Extractors allow use of template tokens as context for expressions that enrich discovery results. For example, given a template /path/${epoch}, an extractor under key "epoch" with an expression {date: new Date(+value*1000)} will enrich discovery results with a human-readable "date" field.

includeMetadata.title: Include metadata
includeMetadata.description: Include Azure Blob metadata in collected events. In each event, metadata will be located at: __collectible.metadata.

includeTags.title: Include tags
includeTags.description: Include Azure Blob tags in collected events. In each event, tags will be located at: __collectible.tags. Disable this feature when using a Shared Access Signature Connection String, to prevent errors.

maxBatchSize.title: Batch size limit
maxBatchSize.description: Maximum number of metadata objects to batch before recording as results

parquetChunkSizeMB.title: Parquet chunk size limit
parquetChunkSizeMB.description: Maximum file size for each Parquet chunk

parquetChunkDownloadTimeout.title: Parquet chunk download timeout (seconds)
parquetChunkDownloadTimeout.description: The maximum time allowed for downloading a Parquet chunk. Processing will abort if a chunk cannot be downloaded within the time specified.

query.title: SQL Query

queryValidationEnabled.title: Validate Query
queryValidationEnabled.description: Enforces a basic query validation that allows only a single 'select' statement. Disable for more complex queries or when using semicolons. connectionTimeout.title: Connection timeout (ms)
connectionTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a connection to complete successfully

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (ms)
requestTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for Kafka to respond to a request

maxRetries.title: Retry limit
maxRetries.description: If messages are failing, you can set the maximum number of retries as high as 100 to prevent loss of data

maxBackOff.title: Backoff limit (ms)
maxBackOff.description: The maximum wait time for a retry, in milliseconds. Default (and minimum) is 30,000 ms (30 seconds); maximum is 180,000 ms (180 seconds).

initialBackoff.title: Initial retry interval (ms)
initialBackoff.description: Initial value used to calculate the retry, in milliseconds. Maximum is 600,000 ms (10 minutes).

backoffRate.title: Backoff multiplier
backoffRate.description: Set the backoff multiplier (2-20) to control the retry frequency for failed messages. For faster retries, use a lower multiplier. For slower retries with more delay between attempts, use a higher multiplier. The multiplier is used in an exponential backoff formula; see the Kafka [documentation](https://kafka.js.org/docs/retry-detailed) for details.

authenticationTimeout.title: Authentication timeout (ms)
authenticationTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for Kafka to respond to an authentication request

reauthenticationThreshold.title: Reauthentication threshold (ms)
reauthenticationThreshold.description: Specifies a time window during which @{product} can reauthenticate if needed. Creates the window measuring backward from the moment when credentials are set to expire.

sessionTimeout.title: Session timeout (ms)
sessionTimeout.description:
Timeout used to detect client failures when using Kafka's group-management facilities.
      If the client sends no heartbeats to the broker before the timeout expires, 
      the broker will remove the client from the group and initiate a rebalance.
      Value must be between the broker's configured group.min.session.timeout.ms and group.max.session.timeout.ms.
      See [Kafka's documentation](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#consumerconfigs_session.timeout.ms) for details.

rebalanceTimeout.title: Rebalance timeout (ms)
rebalanceTimeout.description:
Maximum allowed time for each worker to join the group after a rebalance begins.
      If the timeout is exceeded, the coordinator broker will remove the worker from the group.
      See [Kafka's documentation](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#connectconfigs_rebalance.timeout.ms) for details.

heartbeatInterval.title: Heartbeat interval (ms)
heartbeatInterval.description:
Expected time between heartbeats to the consumer coordinator when using Kafka's group-management facilities.
      Value must be lower than sessionTimeout and typically should not exceed 1/3 of the sessionTimeout value.
      See [Kafka's documentation](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#consumerconfigs_heartbeat.interval.ms) for details.

autoCommitInterval.title: Offset commit interval (ms)
autoCommitInterval.description: How often to commit offsets. If both this and Offset commit threshold are set, @{product} commits offsets when either condition is met. If both are empty, @{product} commits offsets after each batch.

autoCommitThreshold.title: Offset commit threshold
autoCommitThreshold.description: How many events are needed to trigger an offset commit. If both this and Offset commit interval are set, @{product} commits offsets when either condition is met. If both are empty, @{product} commits offsets after each batch.

maxBytesPerPartition.title: Byte limit, per partition
maxBytesPerPartition.description: Maximum amount of data that Kafka will return per partition, per fetch request. Must equal or exceed the maximum message size (maxBytesPerPartition) that Kafka is configured to allow. Otherwise, @{product} can get stuck trying to retrieve messages. Defaults to 1048576 (1 MB).

maxBytes.title: Byte limit
maxBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes that Kafka will return per fetch request. Defaults to 10485760 (10 MB).

maxSocketErrors.title: Error limit, per socket
maxSocketErrors.description: Maximum number of network errors before the consumer re-creates a socket

maxBackOff.title: Backoff limit (ms)
maxBackOff.description: The maximum wait time for a retry, in milliseconds. Default (and minimum) is 30,000 ms (30 seconds); maximum is 180,000 ms (180 seconds).

initialBackoff.title: Initial retry interval (ms)
initialBackoff.description: Initial value used to calculate the retry, in milliseconds. Maximum is 600,000 ms (10 minutes).

backoffRate.title: Backoff multiplier
backoffRate.description: Set the backoff multiplier (2-20) to control the retry frequency for failed messages. For faster retries, use a lower multiplier. For slower retries with more delay between attempts, use a higher multiplier. The multiplier is used in an exponential backoff formula; see the Kafka [documentation](https://kafka.js.org/docs/retry-detailed) for details.

authenticationTimeout.title: Authentication timeout (ms)
authenticationTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for Kafka to respond to an authentication request

reauthenticationThreshold.title: Reauthentication threshold (ms)
reauthenticationThreshold.description: Specifies a time window during which @{product} can reauthenticate if needed. Creates the window measuring backward from the moment when credentials are set to expire.

region.title: Region
region.description: Region where the MSK cluster is located

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: MSK cluster service endpoint. If empty, defaults to the AWS Region-specific endpoint. Otherwise, it must point to MSK cluster-compatible endpoint.

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections
reuseConnections.description: Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

enableAssumeRole.title: Enable for MSK
enableAssumeRole.description: Use Assume Role credentials to access MSK

assumeRoleArn.title: AssumeRole ARN
assumeRoleArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume

assumeRoleExternalId.title: External ID
assumeRoleExternalId.description: External ID to use when assuming role

durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
durationSeconds.description: Duration of the assumed role's session, in seconds. Minimum is 900 (15 minutes), default is 3600 (1 hour), and maximum is 43200 (12 hours).

autoCommitInterval.title: Offset commit interval (ms)
autoCommitInterval.description: How often to commit offsets. If both this and Offset commit threshold are set, @{product} commits offsets when either condition is met. If both are empty, @{product} commits offsets after each batch.

autoCommitThreshold.title: Offset commit threshold
autoCommitThreshold.description: How many events are needed to trigger an offset commit. If both this and Offset commit interval are set, @{product} commits offsets when either condition is met. If both are empty, @{product} commits offsets after each batch.

maxBytesPerPartition.title: Byte limit, per partition
maxBytesPerPartition.description: Maximum amount of data that Kafka will return per partition, per fetch request. Must equal or exceed the maximum message size (maxBytesPerPartition) that Kafka is configured to allow. Otherwise, @{product} can get stuck trying to retrieve messages. Defaults to 1048576 (1 MB).

maxBytes.title: Byte limit
maxBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes that Kafka will return per fetch request. Defaults to 10485760 (10 MB).

maxSocketErrors.title: Error limit, per socket
maxSocketErrors.description: Maximum number of network errors before the consumer re-creates a socket

awsSecret.title: Secret key pair
awsSecret.description: Select or create a stored secret that references your access key and secret key

fromBeginning.title: From beginning
fromBeginning.description: Leave enabled if you want the Source, upon first subscribing to a topic, to read starting with the earliest available message

connectionTimeout.title: Connection timeout (ms)
connectionTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a connection to complete successfully

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (ms)
requestTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for Kafka to respond to a request

maxRetries.title: Retry limit
maxRetries.description: If messages are failing, you can set the maximum number of retries as high as 100 to prevent loss of data

maxBackOff.title: Backoff limit (ms)
maxBackOff.description: The maximum wait time for a retry, in milliseconds. Default (and minimum) is 30,000 ms (30 seconds); maximum is 180,000 ms (180 seconds).

initialBackoff.title: Initial retry interval (ms)
initialBackoff.description: Initial value used to calculate the retry, in milliseconds. Maximum is 600,000 ms (10 minutes).

backoffRate.title: Backoff multiplier
backoffRate.description: Set the backoff multiplier (2-20) to control the retry frequency for failed messages. For faster retries, use a lower multiplier. For slower retries with more delay between attempts, use a higher multiplier. The multiplier is used in an exponential backoff formula; see the Kafka [documentation](https://kafka.js.org/docs/retry-detailed) for details.

authenticationTimeout.title: Authentication timeout (ms)
authenticationTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for Kafka to respond to an authentication request

reauthenticationThreshold.title: Reauthentication threshold (ms)
reauthenticationThreshold.description: Specifies a time window during which @{product} can reauthenticate if needed. Creates the window measuring backward from the moment when credentials are set to expire.

sessionTimeout.title: Session timeout (ms)
sessionTimeout.description:
Timeout used to detect client failures when using Kafka's group-management facilities.
      If the client sends no heartbeats to the broker before the timeout expires, 
      the broker will remove the client from the group and initiate a rebalance.
      Value must be between the broker's configured group.min.session.timeout.ms and group.max.session.timeout.ms.
      See [Kafka's documentation](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#consumerconfigs_session.timeout.ms) for details.

rebalanceTimeout.title: Rebalance timeout (ms)
rebalanceTimeout.description:
Maximum allowed time for each worker to join the group after a rebalance begins.
      If the timeout is exceeded, the coordinator broker will remove the worker from the group.
      See [Kafka's documentation](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#connectconfigs_rebalance.timeout.ms) for details.

heartbeatInterval.title: Heartbeat interval (ms)
heartbeatInterval.description:
Expected time between heartbeats to the consumer coordinator when using Kafka's group-management facilities.
      Value must be lower than sessionTimeout and typically should not exceed 1/3 of the sessionTimeout value.
      See [Kafka's documentation](https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#consumerconfigs_heartbeat.interval.ms) for details.

autoCommitInterval.title: Offset commit interval (ms)
autoCommitInterval.description: How often to commit offsets. If both this and Offset commit threshold are set, @{product} commits offsets when either condition is met. If both are empty, @{product} commits offsets after each batch.

autoCommitThreshold.title: Offset commit threshold
autoCommitThreshold.description: How many events are needed to trigger an offset commit. If both this and Offset commit interval are set, @{product} commits offsets when either condition is met. If both are empty, @{product} commits offsets after each batch.

maxBytesPerPartition.title: Byte limit, per partition
maxBytesPerPartition.description: Maximum amount of data that Kafka will return per partition, per fetch request. Must equal or exceed the maximum message size (maxBytesPerPartition) that Kafka is configured to allow. Otherwise, @{product} can get stuck trying to retrieve messages. Defaults to 1048576 (1 MB).

maxBytes.title: Byte limit
maxBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes that Kafka will return per fetch request. Defaults to 10485760 (10 MB).

maxSocketErrors.title: Error limit, per socket
maxSocketErrors.description: Maximum number of network errors before the consumer re-creates a socket

brokers.title: Brokers
brokers.description: List of Event Hubs Kafka brokers to connect to (example: yourdomain.servicebus.windows.net:9093). The hostname can be found in the host portion of the primary or secondary connection string in Shared Access Policies.

topics.title: Event Hub name
topics.description: The name of the Event Hub (Kafka topic) to subscribe to. Warning: To optimize performance, Cribl suggests subscribing each Event Hubs Source to only a single topic.

groupId.title: Group ID
groupId.description: The consumer group this instance belongs to. Default is 'Cribl'.

fromBeginning.title: From beginning
fromBeginning.description: Start reading from earliest available data; relevant only during initial subscription

connectionTimeout.title: Connection timeout (ms)
connectionTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a connection to complete successfully

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (ms)
requestTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for Kafka to respond to a request

maxRetries.title: Retry limit
maxRetries.description: If messages are failing, you can set the maximum number of retries as high as 100 to prevent loss of data

maxBackOff.title: Backoff limit (ms)
maxBackOff.description: The maximum wait time for a retry, in milliseconds. Default (and minimum) is 30,000 ms (30 seconds); maximum is 180,000 ms (180 seconds).

initialBackoff.title: Initial retry interval (ms)
initialBackoff.description: Initial value used to calculate the retry, in milliseconds. Maximum is 600,000 ms (10 minutes).

backoffRate.title: Backoff multiplier
backoffRate.description: Set the backoff multiplier (2-20) to control the retry frequency for failed messages. For faster retries, use a lower multiplier. For slower retries with more delay between attempts, use a higher multiplier. The multiplier is used in an exponential backoff formula; see the Kafka [documentation](https://kafka.js.org/docs/retry-detailed) for details.

authenticationTimeout.title: Authentication timeout (ms)
authenticationTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for Kafka to respond to an authentication request

reauthenticationThreshold.title: Reauthentication threshold (ms)
reauthenticationThreshold.description: Specifies a time window during which @{product} can reauthenticate if needed. Creates the window measuring backward from the moment when credentials are set to expire.

sessionTimeout.title: Session timeout (ms)
sessionTimeout.description:
Timeout (session.timeout.ms in Kafka domain) used to detect client failures when using Kafka's group-management facilities.
      If the client sends no heartbeats to the broker before the timeout expires, the broker will remove the client from the group and initiate a rebalance.
      Value must be lower than rebalanceTimeout.
      See details [here](https://github.com/Azure/azure-event-hubs-for-kafka/blob/master/CONFIGURATION.md).

rebalanceTimeout.title: Rebalance timeout (ms)
rebalanceTimeout.description:
Maximum allowed time (rebalance.timeout.ms in Kafka domain) for each worker to join the group after a rebalance begins.
      If the timeout is exceeded, the coordinator broker will remove the worker from the group.
      See [Recommended configurations](https://github.com/Azure/azure-event-hubs-for-kafka/blob/master/CONFIGURATION.md).

heartbeatInterval.title: Heartbeat interval (ms)
heartbeatInterval.description:
Expected time (heartbeat.interval.ms in Kafka domain) between heartbeats to the consumer coordinator when using Kafka's group-management facilities.
      Value must be lower than sessionTimeout and typically should not exceed 1/3 of the sessionTimeout value.
      See [Recommended configurations](https://github.com/Azure/azure-event-hubs-for-kafka/blob/master/CONFIGURATION.md).

autoCommitInterval.title: Offset commit interval (ms)
autoCommitInterval.description: How often to commit offsets. If both this and Offset commit threshold are set, @{product} commits offsets when either condition is met. If both are empty, @{product} commits offsets after each batch.

autoCommitThreshold.title: Offset commit threshold
autoCommitThreshold.description: How many events are needed to trigger an offset commit. If both this and Offset commit interval are set, @{product} commits offsets when either condition is met. If both are empty, @{product} commits offsets after each batch.

maxBytesPerPartition.title: Byte limit, per partition
maxBytesPerPartition.description: Maximum amount of data that Kafka will return per partition, per fetch request. Must equal or exceed the maximum message size (maxBytesPerPartition) that Kafka is configured to allow. Otherwise, @{product} can get stuck trying to retrieve messages. Defaults to 1048576 (1 MB).

maxBytes.title: Byte limit
maxBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes that Kafka will return per fetch request. Defaults to 10485760 (10 MB).

maxSocketErrors.title: Error limit, per socket
maxSocketErrors.description: Maximum number of network errors before the consumer re-creates a socket

minimizeDuplicates.title: Minimize duplicates
minimizeDuplicates.description: Minimize duplicate events by starting only one consumer for each topic partition

queueName.title: Queue
queueName.description: The name, URL, or ARN of the SQS queue to read notifications from. When a non-AWS URL is specified, format must be: '{url}/myQueueName'. Example: 'https://host:port/myQueueName'. Value must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `https://host:port/myQueue-${C.vars.myVar}`.

fileFilter.title: Filename filter
fileFilter.description: Regex matching file names to download and process. Defaults to: .*

awsAccountId.title: AWS account ID
awsAccountId.description: SQS queue owner's AWS account ID. Leave empty if SQS queue is in same AWS account.

region.title: Region
region.description: AWS Region where the S3 bucket and SQS queue are located. Required, unless the Queue entry is a URL or ARN that includes a Region.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: S3 service endpoint. If empty, defaults to the AWS Region-specific endpoint. Otherwise, it must point to S3-compatible endpoint.

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections
reuseConnections.description: Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

breakerRulesets.title: Event Breaker rulesets
breakerRulesets.description: A list of event-breaking rulesets that will be applied, in order, to the input data stream

staleChannelFlushMs.title: Event Breaker buffer timeout (ms)
staleChannelFlushMs.description: How long (in milliseconds) the Event Breaker will wait for new data to be sent to a specific channel before flushing the data stream out, as is, to the Pipelines

maxMessages.title: Message limit
maxMessages.description: The maximum number of messages SQS should return in a poll request. Amazon SQS never returns more messages than this value (however, fewer messages might be returned). Valid values: 1 to 10.

visibilityTimeout.title: Visibility timeout seconds
visibilityTimeout.description: After messages are retrieved by a ReceiveMessage request, @{product} will hide them from subsequent retrieve requests for at least this duration. You can set this as high as 43200 sec. (12 hours).

numReceivers.title: Number of receivers
numReceivers.description: How many receiver processes to run. The higher the number, the better the throughput - at the expense of CPU overhead.

socketTimeout.title: Socket timeout
socketTimeout.description: Socket inactivity timeout (in seconds). Increase this value if timeouts occur due to backpressure.

skipOnError.title: Skip file on error
skipOnError.description: Skip files that trigger a processing error. Disabled by default, which allows retries after processing errors.

includeSqsMetadata.title: Include notification metadata
includeSqsMetadata.description: Attach SQS notification metadata to a __sqsMetadata field on each event

enableAssumeRole.title: Enable for Amazon S3
enableAssumeRole.description: Use Assume Role credentials to access Amazon S3

assumeRoleArn.title: AssumeRole ARN
assumeRoleArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume

assumeRoleExternalId.title: External ID
assumeRoleExternalId.description: External ID to use when assuming role

durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
durationSeconds.description: Duration of the assumed role's session, in seconds. Minimum is 900 (15 minutes), default is 3600 (1 hour), and maximum is 43200 (12 hours).

enableSQSAssumeRole.title: Enable for Amazon SQS
enableSQSAssumeRole.description: Use Assume Role credentials when accessing Amazon SQS

pollTimeout.title: Poll timeout (secs)
pollTimeout.description: How long to wait for events before trying polling again. The lower the number the higher the AWS bill. The higher the number the longer it will take for the source to react to configuration changes and system restarts.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: Character encoding to use when parsing ingested data. When not set, @{product} will default to UTF-8 but may incorrectly interpret multi-byte characters.

awsSecret.title: Secret key pair
awsSecret.description: Select or create a stored secret that references your access key and secret key

maxActiveReq.description: Maximum number of active requests allowed per Worker Process. Set to 0 for unlimited. Caution: Increasing the limit above the default value, or setting it to unlimited, may degrade performance and reduce throughput.

maxRequestsPerSocket.title: Requests-per-socket limit
maxRequestsPerSocket.description: Maximum number of requests per socket before @{product} instructs the client to close the connection. Default is 0 (unlimited).

enableProxyHeader.title: Show originating IP
enableProxyHeader.description: Extract the client IP and port from PROXY protocol v1/v2. When enabled, the X-Forwarded-For header is ignored. Disable to use the X-Forwarded-For header for client IP extraction.

captureHeaders.title: Capture request headers
captureHeaders.description: Add request headers to events, in the __headers field

activityLogSampleRate.title: Activity log sample rate
activityLogSampleRate.description: How often request activity is logged at the `info` level. A value of 1 would log every request, 10 every 10th request, etc.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeout.description: How long to wait for an incoming request to complete before aborting it. Use 0 to disable.

socketTimeout.title: Socket timeout (seconds)
socketTimeout.description: How long @{product} should wait before assuming that an inactive socket has timed out. To wait forever, set to 0.

keepAliveTimeout.title: Keep-alive timeout (seconds)
keepAliveTimeout.description: After the last response is sent, @{product} will wait this long for additional data before closing the socket connection. Minimum 1 second, maximum 600 seconds (10 minutes).

enableHealthCheck.title: Health check endpoint
enableHealthCheck.description: Expose the /cribl_health endpoint, which returns 200 OK when this Source is healthy

ipAllowlistRegex.title: IP allowlist regex
ipAllowlistRegex.description: Messages from matched IP addresses will be processed, unless also matched by the denylist

ipDenylistRegex.title: IP denylist regex
ipDenylistRegex.description: Messages from matched IP addresses will be ignored. This takes precedence over the allowlist.

extractMetrics.title: Extract metrics
extractMetrics.description: Toggle to Yes to extract each incoming metric to multiple events, one per data point. This works well when sending metrics to a statsd-type output. If sending metrics to DatadogHQ or any destination that accepts arbitrary JSON, leave toggled to No (the default).

queueName.title: Queue
queueName.description: The name, URL, or ARN of the SQS queue to read notifications from. When a non-AWS URL is specified, format must be: '{url}/myQueueName'. Example: 'https://host:port/myQueueName'. Value must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time.
