fileFilter.title: Filename filter
fileFilter.description: Regex matching file names to download and process. Defaults to: .*

awsAccountId.title: AWS account ID
awsAccountId.description: SQS queue owner's AWS account ID. Leave empty if SQS queue is in same AWS account.

region.title: Region
region.description: AWS Region where the S3 bucket and SQS queue are located. Required, unless the Queue entry is a URL or ARN that includes a Region.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: S3 service endpoint. If empty, defaults to the AWS Region-specific endpoint. Otherwise, it must point to S3-compatible endpoint.

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections
reuseConnections.description: Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

breakerRulesets.title: Event Breaker rulesets
breakerRulesets.description: A list of event-breaking rulesets that will be applied, in order, to the input data stream

staleChannelFlushMs.title: Event Breaker buffer timeout (ms)
staleChannelFlushMs.description: How long (in milliseconds) the Event Breaker will wait for new data to be sent to a specific channel before flushing the data stream out, as is, to the Pipelines

maxMessages.title: Message limit
maxMessages.description: The maximum number of messages SQS should return in a poll request. Amazon SQS never returns more messages than this value (however, fewer messages might be returned). Valid values: 1 to 10.

visibilityTimeout.title: Visibility timeout seconds
visibilityTimeout.description: After messages are retrieved by a ReceiveMessage request, @{product} will hide them from subsequent retrieve requests for at least this duration. You can set this as high as 43200 sec. (12 hours).

numReceivers.title: Number of receivers
numReceivers.description: How many receiver processes to run. The higher the number, the better the throughput - at the expense of CPU overhead.

socketTimeout.title: Socket timeout
socketTimeout.description: Socket inactivity timeout (in seconds). Increase this value if timeouts occur due to backpressure.

skipOnError.title: Skip file on error
skipOnError.description: Skip files that trigger a processing error. Disabled by default, which allows retries after processing errors.

includeSqsMetadata.title: Include notification metadata
includeSqsMetadata.description: Attach SQS notification metadata to a __sqsMetadata field on each event

enableSQSAssumeRole.description: Use Assume Role credentials when accessing Amazon SQS

maxMessages.title: Message limit

visibilityTimeout.title: Visibility Timeout Seconds

udpPort.title: UDP port
udpPort.description: Enter UDP port number to listen on. Not required if listening on TCP.

tcpPort.title: TCP port
tcpPort.description: Enter TCP port number to listen on. Not required if listening on UDP.

maxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events)
maxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to buffer when downstream is blocking. Only applies to UDP.

ipWhitelistRegex.title: IP allowlist regex

timestampTimezone.title: Default timezone
timestampTimezone.description: Timezone to assign to timestamps without timezone info

singleMsgUdpPackets.title: Single msg per UDP
singleMsgUdpPackets.description: Treat UDP packet data received as full syslog message

enableProxyHeader.title: Enable proxy protocol
enableProxyHeader.description: Enable if the connection is proxied by a device that supports Proxy Protocol V1 or V2

keepFieldsList.title: Fields to keep
keepFieldsList.description: Wildcard list of fields to keep from source data; * = ALL (default)

octetCounting.title: Octet count framing
octetCounting.description: Enable if incoming messages use octet counting per RFC 6587.

inferFraming.title: Infer Syslog framing
inferFraming.description: Enable if we should infer the syslog framing of the incoming messages.

strictlyInferOctetCounting.title: Strictly infer octet count framing
strictlyInferOctetCounting.description: Enable if we should infer octet counting only if the messages comply with RFC 5424.

allowNonStandardAppName.title: Allow non-standard app name
allowNonStandardAppName.description: Enable if RFC 3164-formatted messages have hyphens in the app name portion of the TAG section. If disabled, only alphanumeric characters and underscores are allowed. Ignored for RFC 5424-formatted messages.

maxActiveCxn.title: Active connection limit
maxActiveCxn.description: Maximum number of active connections allowed per Worker Process for TCP connections. Use 0 for unlimited.

socketIdleTimeout.title: TCP socket idle timeout (seconds)
socketIdleTimeout.description: How long @{product} should wait before assuming that an inactive socket has timed out. After this time, the connection will be closed. Leave at 0 for no inactive socket monitoring.

socketEndingMaxWait.title: TCP forced socket termination timeout (seconds)
socketEndingMaxWait.description: How long the server will wait after initiating a closure for a client to close its end of the connection. If the client doesn't close the connection within this time, the server will forcefully terminate the socket to prevent resource leaks and ensure efficient connection cleanup and system stability. Leave at 0 for no inactive socket monitoring.

socketMaxLifespan.title: TCP Socket max lifespan (seconds)
socketMaxLifespan.description: The maximum duration a socket can remain open, even if active. This helps manage resources and mitigate issues caused by TCP pinning. Set to 0 to disable.

filterArchivedFiles.description: Apply filename allowlist to file entries in archive file types, like tar or zip.

tailOnly.title: Collect from end
tailOnly.description: Read only new entries at the end of all files discovered at next startup. @{product} will then read newly discovered files from the head. Disable this to resume reading all files from head.

idleTimeout.title: Idle timeout
idleTimeout.description: Time, in seconds, before an idle file is closed

minAgeDur.title: Minimum age duration
minAgeDur.description: The minimum age of files to monitor. Format examples: 30s, 15m, 1h. Age is relative to file modification time. Leave empty to apply no age filters.

maxAgeDur.title: Maximum age duration
maxAgeDur.description: The maximum age of event timestamps to collect. Format examples: 60s, 4h, 3d, 1w. Can be used in conjuction with "Check file modification times". Leave empty to apply no age filters.

checkFileModTime.title: Check file modification times

forceText.title: Force text format

hashLen.title: Hash length
hashLen.description: Length of file header bytes to use in hash for unique file identification

breakerRulesets.title: Event Breaker rulesets
breakerRulesets.description: A list of event-breaking rulesets that will be applied, in order, to the input data stream

disableStaleChannelFlush.title: Disable Event Breaker buffer timeout
disableStaleChannelFlush.description: When enabled, no Event Breaker channel flush timeout applies and the timeout below is ignored. Prefer this option when using header-based breakers for file types such as CSV or IIS.

staleChannelFlushMs.title: Event Breaker buffer timeout (ms)
staleChannelFlushMs.description: How long (in milliseconds) the Event Breaker will wait for new data to be sent to a specific channel before flushing the data stream out, as is, to the Pipelines

path.title: Search path
path.description: Directory path to search for files. Environment variables will be resolved (example: $CRIBL_HOME/log/).

depth.description: Set how many subdirectories deep to search. Use 0 to search only files in the given path, 1 to also look in its immediate subdirectories, etc. Leave it empty for unlimited depth.

suppressMissingPathErrors.title: Suppress errors when search path does not exist

deleteFiles.title: Delete files
deleteFiles.description: Delete files after they have been collected

saltHash.title: Salt file hash
saltHash.description: Salt the file hash with the Source file path. Ensures that all files with the same header hash, such as CSV files, are ingested. Moving or renaming the file, or toggling this after starting the Source will cause re-ingestion.

optimizeLeafDirectories.title: Optimize for leaf directories
optimizeLeafDirectories.description: Skip rescans of unchanged directories based on directory modification time. Uses an exponential backoff strategy, reducing load on the filesystems, but possibly delaying detection of new data. This option is optimized for search paths where files exist in the leaf directories.

includeUnidentifiableBinary.title: Enable binary files
includeUnidentifiableBinary.description: Stream binary files as Base64-encoded chunks

timeWindow.title: Bucket time span

authMethod.description: How to authenticate incoming client connections

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Enable TLS

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate client certs
rejectUnauthorized.description: Required for WEF certificate authentication

privKeyPath.title: Private key path
privKeyPath.description: Path on server containing the private key to use. PEM format. Can reference $ENV_VARS.

passphrase.title: Passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase to use to decrypt private key

certPath.title: Certificate path
certPath.description: Path on server containing certificates to use. PEM format. Can reference $ENV_VARS.

caPath.title: CA certificate path
caPath.description: Server path containing CA certificates (in PEM format) to use. Can reference $ENV_VARS. If multiple certificates are present in a .pem, each must directly certify the one preceding it.

commonNameRegex.title: Common name
commonNameRegex.description: Regex matching allowable common names in peer certificates' subject attribute

ocspCheckFailClose.title: Strict validation
ocspCheckFailClose.description: If enabled, checks will fail on any OCSP error. Otherwise, checks will fail only when a certificate is revoked, ignoring other errors.

maxActiveReq.title: Active request limit
maxActiveReq.description: Maximum number of active requests allowed per Worker Process. Set to 0 for unlimited. Caution: Increasing the limit above the default value, or setting it to unlimited, may degrade performance and reduce throughput.

maxRequestsPerSocket.title: Requests-per-socket limit
maxRequestsPerSocket.description: Maximum number of requests per socket before @{product} instructs the client to close the connection. Default is 0 (unlimited).

enableProxyHeader.title: Show originating IP
enableProxyHeader.description: Preserve the client’s original IP address in the __srcIpPort field when connecting through an HTTP proxy that supports the X-Forwarded-For header. This does not apply to TCP-layer Proxy Protocol v1/v2.

captureHeaders.title: Capture request headers
captureHeaders.description: Add request headers to events in the __headers field

keepAliveTimeout.title: Keep-alive timeout (seconds)
keepAliveTimeout.description: After the last response is sent, @{product} will wait this long for additional data before closing the socket connection. Minimum 1 second, maximum 600 seconds (10 minutes).

enableHealthCheck.title: Health check endpoint
enableHealthCheck.description: Expose the /cribl_health endpoint, which returns 200 OK when this Source is healthy

ipAllowlistRegex.title: IP allowlist regex
ipAllowlistRegex.description: Messages from matched IP addresses will be processed, unless also matched by the denylist

ipDenylistRegex.title: IP denylist regex
ipDenylistRegex.description: Messages from matched IP addresses will be ignored. This takes precedence over the allowlist.

socketTimeout.title: Socket timeout (seconds)
socketTimeout.description: How long @{product} should wait before assuming that an inactive socket has timed out. To wait forever, set to 0.

caFingerprint.title: CA fingerprint override
caFingerprint.description: SHA1 fingerprint expected by the client, if it does not match the first certificate in the configured CA chain

keytab.title: Keytab location
keytab.description: Path to the keytab file containing the service principal credentials. @{product} will use `/etc/krb5.keytab` if not provided.

principal.title: Service principal name
principal.description: Kerberos principal used for authentication, typically in the form HTTP/<hostname>@<REALM>

allowMachineIdMismatch.title: Allow MachineID mismatch
allowMachineIdMismatch.description: Allow events to be ingested even if their MachineID does not match the client certificate CN

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Subscriptions to events on forwarding endpoints

version.title: Version
version.description: Version UUID for this subscription. If any subscription parameters are modified, this value will change.

contentFormat.title: Format
contentFormat.description: Content format in which the endpoint should deliver events

heartbeatInterval.title: Heartbeat
heartbeatInterval.description: Maximum time (in seconds) between endpoint checkins before considering it unavailable

batchTimeout.title: Batch timeout
batchTimeout.description: Interval (in seconds) over which the endpoint should collect events before sending them to Stream

readExistingEvents.title: Read existing events
readExistingEvents.description: Newly subscribed endpoints will send previously existing events. Disable to receive new events only.

sendBookmarks.title: Use bookmarks
sendBookmarks.description: Keep track of which events have been received, resuming from that point after a re-subscription. This setting takes precedence over 'Read existing events'. See [Cribl Docs](https://docs.cribl.io/stream/sources-wef/#subscriptions) for more details.

compress.title: Compression
compress.description: Receive compressed events from the source

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: The DNS names of the endpoints that should forward these events. You may use wildcards, such as *.mydomain.com

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: The RFC-3066 locale the Windows clients should use when sending events. Defaults to "en-US".

stateUpdateExpression.title: State update expression
stateUpdateExpression.description: JavaScript expression that defines how to update the state from an event. Use the event's data and the current state to compute the new state. See [Understanding State Expression Fields](https://docs.cribl.io/stream/collectors-rest#state-tracking-expression-fields) for more information.

stateMergeExpression.title: State merge expression
stateMergeExpression.description: JavaScript expression that defines which state to keep when merging a task's newly reported state with previously saved state. Evaluates `prevState` and `newState` variables, resolving to the state to keep.

contentQuery.description: Template for POST body to send with the Collect request. Reference global variables, or functions using template params: `${C.vars.myVar}`, or `${Date.now()}`, `${param}`.

earliest.title: Earliest time

latest.title: Latest time

jobTimeout.title: Job timeout
jobTimeout.description: Maximum time the job is allowed to run (examples: 30, 45s, 15m). Units default to seconds if not specified. Enter 0 for unlimited time.

maxPages.title: Page limit
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to retrieve per collection task. Defaults to 0. Set to 0 to retrieve all pages.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeout.description: HTTP request inactivity timeout. Use 0 to disable.

keepAliveTime.title: Keep alive time (seconds)
keepAliveTime.description: How often workers should check in with the scheduler to keep job subscription alive

maxMissedKeepAlives.title: Worker timeout (periods)
maxMissedKeepAlives.description: The number of Keep Alive Time periods before an inactive worker will have its job subscription revoked.

ttl.title: Time to live
ttl.description: Time to keep the job's artifacts on disk after job completion. This also affects how long a job is listed in the Job Inspector.

ignoreGroupJobsLimit.title: Ignore Worker Group job limits
ignoreGroupJobsLimit.description: When enabled, this job's artifacts are not counted toward the Worker Group's finished job artifacts limit. Artifacts will be removed only after the Collector's configured time to live.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate server certs

        Enabled by default. When this setting is also present in TLS Settings (Client Side), 
        that value will take precedence.

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Body size limit.

extraHttpHeaders.title: Extra HTTP headers

useRoundRobinDns.title: Round-robin DNS
useRoundRobinDns.description: Enable round-robin DNS lookup. When a DNS server returns multiple addresses, @{product} will cycle through them in the order returned. For optimal performance, consider enabling this setting for non-load balanced destinations.

safeHeaders.title: Safe headers
safeHeaders.description: List of headers that are safe to log in plain text

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

authType.title: Authentication type

totalMemoryLimitKB.title: Buffer memory limit (KB)
totalMemoryLimitKB.description: Maximum total size of the batches waiting to be sent. If left blank, defaults to 5 times the max body size (if set). If 0, no limit is enforced.

loadBalanced.title: Load balancing
loadBalanced.description: Enable for optimal performance. Even if you have one hostname, it can expand to multiple IPs. If disabled, consider enabling round-robin DNS.

formatEventCode.title: Format inbound event
formatEventCode.description: Custom JavaScript code to format incoming event data accessible through the __e variable. The formatted content is added to (__e['__eventOut']) if available. Otherwise, the original event is serialized as JSON. Caution: This function is evaluated in an unprotected context, allowing you to execute almost any JavaScript code.

formatPayloadCode.title: Format outbound payload
formatPayloadCode.description: Optional JavaScript code to format the payload sent to the Destination. Caution: This function is evaluated in an unprotected context, allowing you to execute almost any JavaScript code.

pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)

extraHttpHeaders.title: Extra HTTP headers
extraHttpHeaders.description: Headers to add to all events

useRoundRobinDns.title: Round-robin DNS

safeHeaders.title: Safe headers
safeHeaders.description: List of headers that are safe to log in plain text

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

textSecret.title: Auth token (text secret)

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

systemFields.title: System fields
systemFields.description: Fields to automatically add to events, such as cribl_pipe. Supports wildcards.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

destPath.title: Output location
destPath.description: Final destination for the output files

stagePath.title: Staging location
stagePath.description: Filesystem location in which to buffer files, before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage.

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID
addIdToStagePath.description: Add the Output ID value to staging location

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories
removeEmptyDirs.description: Remove empty staging directories after moving files

partitionExpr.title: Partitioning expression
partitionExpr.description: JavaScript expression defining how files are partitioned and organized. Default is date-based. If blank, Stream will fall back to the event's __partition field value – if present – otherwise to each location's root directory.

baseFileName.title: File name prefix expression
baseFileName.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename prefix (can be constant)

fileNameSuffix.title: File name suffix expression
fileNameSuffix.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename suffix (can be constant).  The `__format` variable refers to the value of the `Data format` field (`json` or `raw`).  The `__compression` field refers to the kind of compression being used (`none` or `gzip`).

maxFileSizeMB.title: File size limit (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)
maxFileOpenTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

headerLine.title: Header line
headerLine.description: If set, this line will be written to the beginning of each output file

writeHighWaterMark.title: Writing high watermark (KB)
writeHighWaterMark.description: Buffer size used to write to a file

deadletterEnabled.title: Enable dead-lettering
deadletterEnabled.description: If a file fails to move to its final destination after the maximum number of retries, move it to a designated directory to prevent further errors

forceCloseOnShutdown.title: Force close on shutdown
forceCloseOnShutdown.description: Force all staged files to close during an orderly Node shutdown. This triggers immediate upload of in-progress data — regardless of idle time, file age, or size thresholds — to minimize data loss.

automaticSchema.title: Automatic schema
automaticSchema.description: Automatically calculate the schema based on the events of each Parquet file generated

parquetSchema.title: Parquet schema
parquetSchema.description: To add a new schema, navigate to Processing > Knowledge > Parquet Schemas

parquetRowGroupLength.title: Group row limit
parquetRowGroupLength.description: The number of rows that every group will contain. The final group can contain a smaller number of rows.

parquetPageSize.title: Page size
parquetPageSize.description: Target memory size for page segments, such as 1MB or 128MB. Generally, lower values improve reading speed, while higher values improve compression.

shouldLogInvalidRows.title: Log invalid rows
shouldLogInvalidRows.description: Log up to 3 rows that @{product} skips due to data mismatch

keyValueMetadata.title: Metadata (optional)
keyValueMetadata.description: The metadata of files the Destination writes will include the properties you add here as key-value pairs. Useful for tagging. Examples: "key":"OCSF Event Class", "value":"9001"

enableStatistics.title: Write statistics
enableStatistics.description: Statistics profile an entire file in terms of minimum/maximum values within data, numbers of nulls, etc. You can use Parquet tools to view statistics.

enableWritePageIndex.title: Write page indexes
enableWritePageIndex.description: One page index contains statistics for one data page. Parquet readers use statistics to enable page skipping.

enablePageChecksum.title: Write page checksum
enablePageChecksum.description: Parquet tools can use the checksum of a Parquet page to verify data integrity

emptyDirCleanupSec.title: Staging cleanup period
emptyDirCleanupSec.description: How frequently, in seconds, to clean up empty directories

directoryBatchSize.title: Directory batch size
directoryBatchSize.description: Number of directories to process in each batch during cleanup of empty directories. Minimum is 10, maximum is 10000. Higher values may require more memory.

deadletterPath.title: Dead-letter location
deadletterPath.description: Storage location for files that fail to reach their final destination after maximum retries are exceeded

maxRetryNum.title: Retry limit
maxRetryNum.description: The maximum number of times a file will attempt to move to its final destination before being dead-lettered

createContainer.description: Create the configured container in Azure Blob Storage if it does not already exist

destPath.title: Blob prefix
destPath.description: Root directory prepended to path before uploading. Value can be a JavaScript expression enclosed in quotes or backticks, to be evaluated at initialization. The expression can evaluate to a constant value and can reference Global Variables, such as `myBlobPrefix-${C.env["CRIBL_WORKER_ID"]}`.

stagePath.title: Staging location
stagePath.description: Filesystem location in which to buffer files before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage.

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID
addIdToStagePath.description: Add the Output ID value to staging location

maxConcurrentFileParts.title: Concurrent file parts limit
maxConcurrentFileParts.description: Maximum number of parts to upload in parallel per file

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories
removeEmptyDirs.description: Remove empty staging directories after moving files

partitionExpr.title: Partitioning expression
partitionExpr.description: JavaScript expression defining how files are partitioned and organized. Default is date-based. If blank, Stream will fall back to the event's __partition field value – if present – otherwise to each location's root directory.

baseFileName.title: File name prefix expression
baseFileName.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename prefix (can be constant)

fileNameSuffix.title: File name suffix expression
fileNameSuffix.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename suffix (can be constant).  The `__format` variable refers to the value of the `Data format` field (`json` or `raw`).  The `__compression` field refers to the kind of compression being used (`none` or `gzip`).

maxFileSizeMB.title: File size limit (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)
maxFileOpenTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

headerLine.title: Header line
headerLine.description: If set, this line will be written to the beginning of each output file

writeHighWaterMark.title: Writing high watermark (KB)
writeHighWaterMark.description: Buffer size used to write to a file

deadletterEnabled.title: Enable dead-lettering
deadletterEnabled.description: If a file fails to move to its final destination after the maximum number of retries, move it to a designated directory to prevent further errors

forceCloseOnShutdown.title: Force close on shutdown
forceCloseOnShutdown.description: Force all staged files to close during an orderly Node shutdown. This triggers immediate upload of in-progress data — regardless of idle time, file age, or size thresholds — to minimize data loss.

automaticSchema.title: Automatic schema
automaticSchema.description: Automatically calculate the schema based on the events of each Parquet file generated

parquetSchema.title: Parquet schema
parquetSchema.description: To add a new schema, navigate to Processing > Knowledge > Parquet Schemas

parquetRowGroupLength.title: Group row limit
parquetRowGroupLength.description: The number of rows that every group will contain. The final group can contain a smaller number of rows.

parquetPageSize.title: Page size
parquetPageSize.description: Target memory size for page segments, such as 1MB or 128MB. Generally, lower values improve reading speed, while higher values improve compression.

shouldLogInvalidRows.title: Log invalid rows
shouldLogInvalidRows.description: Log up to 3 rows that @{product} skips due to data mismatch

keyValueMetadata.title: Metadata (optional)
keyValueMetadata.description: The metadata of files the Destination writes will include the properties you add here as key-value pairs. Useful for tagging. Examples: "key":"OCSF Event Class", "value":"9001"

enableStatistics.title: Write statistics
enableStatistics.description: Statistics profile an entire file in terms of minimum/maximum values within data, numbers of nulls, etc. You can use Parquet tools to view statistics.

enableWritePageIndex.title: Write page indexes
enableWritePageIndex.description: One page index contains statistics for one data page. Parquet readers use statistics to enable page skipping.

enablePageChecksum.title: Write page checksum
enablePageChecksum.description: Parquet tools can use the checksum of a Parquet page to verify data integrity

emptyDirCleanupSec.title: Staging cleanup period
emptyDirCleanupSec.description: How frequently, in seconds, to clean up empty directories

directoryBatchSize.title: Directory batch size
directoryBatchSize.description: Number of directories to process in each batch during cleanup of empty directories. Minimum is 10, maximum is 10000. Higher values may require more memory.

deadletterPath.title: Dead-letter location
deadletterPath.description: Storage location for files that fail to reach their final destination after maximum retries are exceeded

maxRetryNum.title: Retry limit
maxRetryNum.description: The maximum number of times a file will attempt to move to its final destination before being dead-lettered

connectionString.title: Connection string
connectionString.description: Enter your Azure Storage account connection string. If left blank, Stream will fall back to env.AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING.

textSecret.title: Connection string (text secret)
textSecret.description: Select or create a stored text secret

storageAccountName.title: Storage account name
storageAccountName.description: The name of your Azure storage account

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: The service principal's tenant ID

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: The service principal's client ID

azureCloud.title: Azure Cloud
azureCloud.description: The Azure cloud to use. Defaults to Azure Public Cloud.

endpointSuffix.title: Endpoint suffix
endpointSuffix.description: Endpoint suffix for the service URL. Takes precedence over the Azure Cloud setting. Defaults to core.windows.net.

clientTextSecret.title: Client secret (text secret)
clientTextSecret.description: Select or create a stored text secret

additionalProperties.description: Optionally, enter additional configuration properties to send to the ingestion service

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

concurrency.title: Request concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of ongoing requests before blocking

maxPayloadSizeKB.title: Body size limit (KB)
maxPayloadSizeKB.description: Maximum size, in KB, of the request body

maxPayloadEvents.title: Events-per-request limit
maxPayloadEvents.description: Maximum number of events to include in the request body. Default is 0 (unlimited).

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Body size limit.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate server certs
rejectUnauthorized.description:
Reject certificates not authorized by a CA in the CA certificate path or by another trusted CA (such as the system's). 
        Enabled by default. When this setting is also present in TLS Settings (Client Side), 
        that value will take precedence.

useRoundRobinDns.title: Round-robin DNS
useRoundRobinDns.description: Enable round-robin DNS lookup. When a DNS server returns multiple addresses, @{product} will cycle through them in the order returned. For optimal performance, consider enabling this setting for non-load balanced destinations.

keepAlive.title: Keep alive
keepAlive.description: Disable to close the connection immediately after sending the outgoing request

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

bucket.description: Name of the destination bucket. This value can be a constant or a JavaScript expression that can only be evaluated at init time. Example of referencing a Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`.

region.title: Region
region.description: Region where the bucket is located

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Google Cloud Storage service endpoint

stagePath.title: Staging location
stagePath.description: Filesystem location in which to buffer files, before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage.

destPath.title: Key prefix
destPath.description: Prefix to prepend to files before uploading. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myKeyPrefix-${C.vars.myVar}`

verifyPermissions.title: Verify if bucket exists
verifyPermissions.description: Disable if you can access files within the bucket but not the bucket itself

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections
reuseConnections.description: Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID
addIdToStagePath.description: Add the Output ID value to staging location

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories
removeEmptyDirs.description: Remove empty staging directories after moving files

partitionExpr.title: Partitioning expression
partitionExpr.description: JavaScript expression defining how files are partitioned and organized. Default is date-based. If blank, Stream will fall back to the event's __partition field value – if present – otherwise to each location's root directory.

baseFileName.title: File name prefix expression
baseFileName.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename prefix (can be constant)

fileNameSuffix.title: File name suffix expression
fileNameSuffix.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename suffix (can be constant).  The `__format` variable refers to the value of the `Data format` field (`json` or `raw`).  The `__compression` field refers to the kind of compression being used (`none` or `gzip`).

maxFileSizeMB.title: File size limit (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)
maxFileOpenTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

headerLine.title: Header line
headerLine.description: If set, this line will be written to the beginning of each output file

writeHighWaterMark.title: Writing high watermark (KB)
writeHighWaterMark.description: Buffer size used to write to a file

deadletterEnabled.title: Enable dead-lettering
deadletterEnabled.description: If a file fails to move to its final destination after the maximum number of retries, move it to a designated directory to prevent further errors

forceCloseOnShutdown.title: Force close on shutdown
forceCloseOnShutdown.description: Force all staged files to close during an orderly Node shutdown. This triggers immediate upload of in-progress data — regardless of idle time, file age, or size thresholds — to minimize data loss.

automaticSchema.title: Automatic schema
automaticSchema.description: Automatically calculate the schema based on the events of each Parquet file generated

parquetSchema.title: Parquet schema
parquetSchema.description: To add a new schema, navigate to Processing > Knowledge > Parquet Schemas

parquetRowGroupLength.title: Group row limit
parquetRowGroupLength.description: The number of rows that every group will contain. The final group can contain a smaller number of rows.

parquetPageSize.title: Page size
parquetPageSize.description: Target memory size for page segments, such as 1MB or 128MB. Generally, lower values improve reading speed, while higher values improve compression.

shouldLogInvalidRows.title: Log invalid rows
shouldLogInvalidRows.description: Log up to 3 rows that @{product} skips due to data mismatch

keyValueMetadata.title: Metadata (optional)
keyValueMetadata.description: The metadata of files the Destination writes will include the properties you add here as key-value pairs. Useful for tagging. Examples: "key":"OCSF Event Class", "value":"9001"

enableStatistics.title: Write statistics
enableStatistics.description: Statistics profile an entire file in terms of minimum/maximum values within data, numbers of nulls, etc. You can use Parquet tools to view statistics.

enableWritePageIndex.title: Write page indexes
enableWritePageIndex.description: One page index contains statistics for one data page. Parquet readers use statistics to enable page skipping.

enablePageChecksum.title: Write page checksum
enablePageChecksum.description: Parquet tools can use the checksum of a Parquet page to verify data integrity

emptyDirCleanupSec.title: Staging cleanup period
emptyDirCleanupSec.description: How frequently, in seconds, to clean up empty directories

directoryBatchSize.title: Directory batch size
directoryBatchSize.description: Number of directories to process in each batch during cleanup of empty directories. Minimum is 10, maximum is 10000. Higher values may require more memory.

deadletterPath.title: Dead-letter location
deadletterPath.description: Storage location for files that fail to reach their final destination after maximum retries are exceeded

maxRetryNum.title: Retry limit
maxRetryNum.description: The maximum number of times a file will attempt to move to its final destination before being dead-lettered

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Pipeline to process data before sending out to this output

systemFields.title: System fields
systemFields.description: Fields to automatically add to events, such as cribl_pipe. Supports wildcards.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

logNameExpression.title: Log name expression
logNameExpression.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value of the log name. If Validate and correct log name is enabled, invalid characters (characters other than alphanumerics, forward-slashes, underscores, hyphens, and periods) will be replaced with an underscore.

payloadFormat.title: Payload format
payloadFormat.description: Format to use when sending payload. Defaults to Text.

logLabels.title: Log labels
logLabels.description: Labels to apply to the log entry

resourceTypeExpression.title: Resource type expression
resourceTypeExpression.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value of the managed resource type field. Must evaluate to one of the valid values [here](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/api/v2/resource-list#resource-types). Defaults to "global".

resourceTypeLabels.title: Resource labels
resourceTypeLabels.description: Labels to apply to the managed resource. These must correspond to the valid labels for the specified resource type (see [here](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/api/v2/resource-list#resource-types)). Otherwise, they will be dropped by Google Cloud Logging.

severityExpression.title: Severity expression
severityExpression.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value of the severity field. Must evaluate to one of the severity values supported by Google Cloud Logging [here](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logseverity) (case insensitive). Defaults to "DEFAULT".

insertIdExpression.title: Insert ID expression
insertIdExpression.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value of the insert ID field.

serviceAccountCredentials.title: Service account credentials
serviceAccountCredentials.description: Contents of service account credentials (JSON keys) file downloaded from Google Cloud. To upload a file, click the upload button at this field's upper right.

secret.title: Service account credentials (text secret)
secret.description: Select or create a stored text secret

maxPayloadSizeKB.title: Body size limit (KB)
maxPayloadSizeKB.description: Maximum size, in KB, of the request body.

maxPayloadEvents.title: Events-per-request limit
maxPayloadEvents.description: Max number of events to include in the request body. Default is 0 (unlimited).

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Max record size.

concurrency.title: Request concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of ongoing requests before blocking.

connectionTimeout.title: Connection timeout
connectionTimeout.description: Amount of time (milliseconds) to wait for the connection to establish before retrying

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout
timeoutSec.description: Amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a request to complete before canceling it.

throttleRateReqPerSec.title: Throttle request rate
throttleRateReqPerSec.description: Maximum number of requests to limit to per second.

requestMethodExpression.title: Request method expression
requestMethodExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request method as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

requestUrlExpression.title: Request URL expression
requestUrlExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request URL as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

requestSizeExpression.title: Request size expression
requestSizeExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request size as a string, in int64 format. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

statusExpression.title: Request status expression
statusExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request method as a number. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

responseSizeExpression.title: Response size expression
responseSizeExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP response size as a string, in int64 format. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

userAgentExpression.title: Request user agent expression
userAgentExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request user agent as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

remoteIpExpression.title: Remote IP expression
remoteIpExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request remote IP as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

serverIpExpression.title: Server IP expression
serverIpExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request server IP as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

refererExpression.title: Referer expression
refererExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request referer as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

latencyExpression.title: Latency expression
latencyExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request latency, formatted as <seconds>.<nanoseconds>s (for example, 1.23s). See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

cacheLookupExpression.title: Cache lookup expression
cacheLookupExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request cache lookup as a boolean. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

cacheHitExpression.title: Cache hit expression
cacheHitExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request cache hit as a boolean. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

cacheValidatedExpression.title: Cache validated with origin server expression
cacheValidatedExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request cache validated with origin server as a boolean. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

cacheFillBytesExpression.title: Cache fill bytes expression
cacheFillBytesExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request cache fill bytes as a string, in int64 format. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

protocolExpression.title: Protocol expression
protocolExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the HTTP request protocol as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#httprequest) for details.

idExpression.title: ID expression
idExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry operation ID as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logentryoperation) for details.

producerExpression.title: Producer expression
producerExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry operation producer as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logentryoperation) for details.

firstExpression.title: First expression
firstExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry operation first flag as a boolean. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logentryoperation) for details.

lastExpression.title: Last expression
lastExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry operation last flag as a boolean. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logentryoperation) for details.

fileExpression.title: File expression
fileExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry source location file as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logentrysourcelocation) for details.

lineExpression.title: Line expression
lineExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry source location line as a string, in int64 format. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logentrysourcelocation) for details.

functionExpression.title: Function expression
functionExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry source location function as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logentrysourcelocation) for details.

uidExpression.title: UID expression
uidExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry log split UID as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logsplit) for details.

indexExpression.title: Index expression
indexExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry log split index as a number. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logsplit) for details.

totalSplitsExpression.title: Total splits expression
totalSplitsExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the log entry log split total splits as a number. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#logsplit) for details.

traceExpression.title: Trace expression
traceExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the REST resource name of the trace being written as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry) for details.

spanIdExpression.title: Span ID expression
spanIdExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the ID of the cloud trace span associated with the current operation in which the log is being written as a string. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry) for details.

traceSampledExpression.title: Trace sampled expression
traceSampledExpression.description: A JavaScript expression that evaluates to the the sampling decision of the span associated with the log entry. See the [documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry) for details.

totalMemoryLimitKB.title: Buffer memory limit (KB)
totalMemoryLimitKB.description: Maximum total size of the batches waiting to be sent. If left blank, defaults to 5 times the max body size (if set). If 0, no limit is enforced.

logLocationExpression.title: Folder ID expression
logLocationExpression.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value of the folder ID with which log entries should be associated. If Validate and correct log name is enabled, invalid characters (characters other than alphanumerics, forward-slashes, underscores, hyphens, and periods) will be replaced with an underscore.

payloadExpression.title: Payload object expression
payloadExpression.description: JavaScript expression to compute the value of the payload. Must evaluate to a JavaScript object value. If an invalid value is encountered it will result in the default value instead. Defaults to the entire event.

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

bucket.title: Bucket name
bucket.description: Name of the destination bucket. A constant or a JavaScript expression that can only be evaluated at init time. Example of referencing a JavaScript Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`.

region.title: Region
region.description: Region where the bucket is located

stagePath.title: Staging location
stagePath.description: Filesystem location in which to buffer files, before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Google Cloud Storage service endpoint

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections
reuseConnections.description: Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID
addIdToStagePath.description: Add the Output ID value to staging location

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories
removeEmptyDirs.description: Remove empty staging directories after moving files

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)
maxFileOpenTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

deadletterEnabled.title: Enable dead-lettering
deadletterEnabled.description: If a file fails to move to its final destination after the maximum number of retries, move it to a designated directory to prevent further errors

maxFileSizeMB.title: File size limit (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location.

encodedConfiguration.title: Exabeam connection string
encodedConfiguration.description: Enter an encoded string containing Exabeam configurations

collectorInstanceId.title: Collector instance ID
collectorInstanceId.description: ID of the Exabeam Collector where data should be sent. Example: 11112222-3333-4444-5555-666677778888

siteName.title: Site name
siteName.description: Constant or JavaScript expression to create an Exabeam site name. Values that aren't successfully evaluated will be treated as string constants.

siteId.title: Site ID
siteId.description: Exabeam site ID. If left blank, @{product} will use the value of the Exabeam site name.

awsApiKey.title: Access key
awsApiKey.description: HMAC access key. Can be a constant or a JavaScript expression, such as `${C.env.GCS_ACCESS_KEY}`.

awsSecretKey.title: Secret
awsSecretKey.description: HMAC secret. Can be a constant or a JavaScript expression, such as `${C.env.GCS_SECRET}`.

emptyDirCleanupSec.title: Staging cleanup period
emptyDirCleanupSec.description: How frequently, in seconds, to clean up empty directories

directoryBatchSize.title: Directory batch size
directoryBatchSize.description: Number of directories to process in each batch during cleanup of empty directories. Minimum is 10, maximum is 10000. Higher values may require more memory.

deadletterPath.title: Dead-letter location
deadletterPath.description: Storage location for files that fail to reach their final destination after maximum retries are exceeded

topic.title: Topic

maxRecordSizeKB.title: Record size limit (KB, uncompressed)
maxRecordSizeKB.description: Maximum size of each record batch before compression. The value must not exceed the Kafka brokers' message.max.bytes setting.

flushEventCount.title: Events-per-batch limit
flushEventCount.description: The maximum number of events you want the Destination to allow in a batch before forcing a flush

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: The maximum amount of time you want the Destination to wait before forcing a flush. Shorter intervals tend to result in smaller batches being sent.

connectionTimeout.title: Connection timeout (ms)

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (ms)

maxRetries.title: Retry limit
maxRetries.description: If messages are failing, you can set the maximum number of retries as high as 100 to prevent loss of data

maxBackOff.title: Backoff limit (ms)
maxBackOff.description: The maximum wait time for a retry, in milliseconds. Default (and minimum) is 30,000 ms (30 seconds); maximum is 180,000 ms (180 seconds).

initialBackoff.title: Initial retry interval (ms)
initialBackoff.description: Initial value used to calculate the retry, in milliseconds. Maximum is 600,000 ms (10 minutes).

backoffRate.title: Backoff multiplier
backoffRate.description: Set the backoff multiplier (2-20) to control the retry frequency for failed messages. For faster retries, use a lower multiplier. For slower retries with more delay between attempts, use a higher multiplier. The multiplier is used in an exponential backoff formula; see the Kafka [documentation](https://kafka.js.org/docs/retry-detailed) for details.

authenticationTimeout.title: Authentication timeout (ms)

reauthenticationThreshold.title: Reauthentication threshold (ms)

protobufEncodingId.title: Object type
protobufEncodingId.description: Select the type of object you want the Protobuf definitions to use for event encoding

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

loadBalanced.title: Load balancing
loadBalanced.description: Enable for optimal performance. Even if you have one hostname, it can expand to multiple IPs. If disabled, consider enabling round-robin DNS.

index.title: Index or data stream
index.description: Index or data stream to send events to. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be overwritten by an event's __index field.

docType.title: Type
docType.description: Document type to use for events. Can be overwritten by an event's __type field.

concurrency.title: Request concurrency

maxPayloadSizeKB.description: Maximum size, in KB, of the request body

maxPayloadEvents.title: Events-per-request limit
maxPayloadEvents.description: Maximum number of events to include in the request body. Default is 0 (unlimited).

compress.title: Compress
compress.description: Compress the payload body before sending

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate server certs
rejectUnauthorized.description:
Reject certificates not authorized by a CA in the CA certificate path or by another trusted CA (such as the system's). 
        Enabled by default. When this setting is also present in TLS Settings (Client Side), 
        that value will take precedence.

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout
timeoutSec.description: Amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a request to complete before canceling it

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Body size limit.

extraHttpHeaders.title: Extra HTTP headers
extraHttpHeaders.description: Headers to add to all events

safeHeaders.title: Safe headers
safeHeaders.description: List of headers that are safe to log in plain text

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

elasticVersion.title: Elastic version
elasticVersion.description: Optional Elasticsearch version, used to format events. If not specified, will auto-discover version.

includeDocId.title: Include document _id
includeDocId.description: Include the `document_id` field when sending events to an Elastic TSDS (time series data stream)

writeAction.title: Write action
writeAction.description: Action to use when writing events. Must be set to `Create` when writing to a data stream.

retryPartialErrors.title: Retry partial errors
retryPartialErrors.description: Retry failed events when a bulk request to Elastic is successful, but the response body returns an error for one or more events in the batch

url.title: Bulk API URL or Cloud ID
url.description: The Cloud ID or URL to an Elastic cluster to send events to. Example: http://elastic:9200/_bulk

useRoundRobinDns.title: Round-robin DNS
useRoundRobinDns.description: Enable round-robin DNS lookup. When a DNS server returns multiple addresses, @{product} will cycle through them in the order returned. For optimal performance, consider enabling this setting for non-load balanced destinations.

excludeSelf.title: Exclude current host IPs
excludeSelf.description: Exclude all IPs of the current host from the list of any resolved hostnames

url.description: The URL to an Elastic node to send events to. Example: http://elastic:9200/_bulk

weight.title: Load Weight
weight.description: Assign a weight (>0) to each endpoint to indicate its traffic-handling capability

index.title: Data stream or index
index.description: Data stream or index to send events to. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be overwritten by an event's __index field.

concurrency.title: Request concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of ongoing requests before blocking

maxPayloadSizeKB.title: Body size limit (KB)
maxPayloadSizeKB.description: Maximum size, in KB, of the request body

maxPayloadEvents.title: Events-per-request limit
maxPayloadEvents.description: Maximum number of events to include in the request body. Default is 0 (unlimited).

compress.title: Compress
compress.description: Compress the payload body before sending

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate server certs
rejectUnauthorized.description:
Reject certificates not authorized by a CA in the CA certificate path or by another trusted CA (such as the system's). 
        Enabled by default. When this setting is also present in TLS Settings (Client Side), 
        that value will take precedence.

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout
timeoutSec.description: Amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a request to complete before canceling it

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Body size limit.

extraHttpHeaders.title: Extra HTTP headers
extraHttpHeaders.description: Headers to add to all events

safeHeaders.title: Safe headers
safeHeaders.description: List of headers that are safe to log in plain text

extraParams.title: Extra parameters
extraParams.description: Extra parameters to use in HTTP requests

includeDocId.title: Include document _id
includeDocId.description: Include the `document_id` field when sending events to an Elastic TSDS (time series data stream)

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.
