systemFields.title: System fields
systemFields.description: Fields to automatically add to events, such as cribl_pipe. Supports wildcards.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections
reuseConnections.description: Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

bucket.title: MinIO bucket name
bucket.description: Name of the destination MinIO bucket. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at initialization time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`

region.title: Region
region.description: Region where the MinIO bucket is located

destPath.title: Key prefix
destPath.description: Prefix to prepend to files before uploading. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myKeyPrefix-${C.vars.myVar}`

maxConcurrentFileParts.title: Concurrent file parts upload limit
maxConcurrentFileParts.description: Maximum number of parts to upload in parallel per file. Minimum part size is 5MB.

verifyPermissions.title: Verify if bucket exists
verifyPermissions.description: Disable if you can access files within the bucket but not the bucket itself

maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.title: Staging file limit
maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.description: Maximum number of files that can be waiting for upload before backpressure is applied

stagePath.title: Staging location
stagePath.description: Filesystem location in which to buffer files, before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage.

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID
addIdToStagePath.description: Add the Output ID value to staging location

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories
removeEmptyDirs.description: Remove empty staging directories after moving files

partitionExpr.title: Partitioning expression
partitionExpr.description: JavaScript expression defining how files are partitioned and organized. Default is date-based. If blank, Stream will fall back to the event's __partition field value – if present – otherwise to each location's root directory.

baseFileName.title: File name prefix expression
baseFileName.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename prefix (can be constant)

fileNameSuffix.title: File name suffix expression
fileNameSuffix.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename suffix (can be constant).  The `__format` variable refers to the value of the `Data format` field (`json` or `raw`).  The `__compression` field refers to the kind of compression being used (`none` or `gzip`).

maxFileSizeMB.title: File size limit (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)
maxFileOpenTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

headerLine.title: Header line
headerLine.description: If set, this line will be written to the beginning of each output file

writeHighWaterMark.title: Writing high watermark (KB)
writeHighWaterMark.description: Buffer size used to write to a file

deadletterEnabled.title: Enable dead-lettering
deadletterEnabled.description: If a file fails to move to its final destination after the maximum number of retries, move it to a designated directory to prevent further errors

forceCloseOnShutdown.title: Force close on shutdown
forceCloseOnShutdown.description: Force all staged files to close during an orderly Node shutdown. This triggers immediate upload of in-progress data — regardless of idle time, file age, or size thresholds — to minimize data loss.

awsSecretKey.title: Secret key
awsSecretKey.description: Secret key. This value can be a constant or a JavaScript expression. Example: `${C.env.SOME_SECRET}`)

endpoint.title: MinIO endpoint
endpoint.description: MinIO service url (e.g. http://minioHost:9000)

awsApiKey.title: Access key
awsApiKey.description: This value can be a constant or a JavaScript expression (`${C.env.SOME_ACCESS_KEY}`)

awsSecret.title: Secret key pair
awsSecret.description: Select or create a stored secret that references your access key and secret key

automaticSchema.title: Automatic schema
automaticSchema.description: Automatically calculate the schema based on the events of each Parquet file generated

parquetSchema.title: Parquet schema
parquetSchema.description: To add a new schema, navigate to Processing > Knowledge > Parquet Schemas

parquetRowGroupLength.title: Group row limit
parquetRowGroupLength.description: The number of rows that every group will contain. The final group can contain a smaller number of rows.

parquetPageSize.title: Page size
parquetPageSize.description: Target memory size for page segments, such as 1MB or 128MB. Generally, lower values improve reading speed, while higher values improve compression.

shouldLogInvalidRows.title: Log invalid rows
shouldLogInvalidRows.description: Log up to 3 rows that @{product} skips due to data mismatch

keyValueMetadata.title: Metadata (optional)
keyValueMetadata.description: The metadata of files the Destination writes will include the properties you add here as key-value pairs. Useful for tagging. Examples: "key":"OCSF Event Class", "value":"9001"

enableStatistics.title: Write statistics
enableStatistics.description: Statistics profile an entire file in terms of minimum/maximum values within data, numbers of nulls, etc. You can use Parquet tools to view statistics.

enableWritePageIndex.title: Write page indexes
enableWritePageIndex.description: One page index contains statistics for one data page. Parquet readers use statistics to enable page skipping.

enablePageChecksum.title: Write page checksum
enablePageChecksum.description: Parquet tools can use the checksum of a Parquet page to verify data integrity

emptyDirCleanupSec.title: Staging cleanup period
emptyDirCleanupSec.description: How frequently, in seconds, to clean up empty directories

directoryBatchSize.title: Directory batch size
directoryBatchSize.description: Number of directories to process in each batch during cleanup of empty directories. Minimum is 10, maximum is 10000. Higher values may require more memory.

deadletterPath.title: Dead-letter location
deadletterPath.description: Storage location for files that fail to reach their final destination after maximum retries are exceeded

maxRetryNum.title: Retry limit
maxRetryNum.description: The maximum number of times a file will attempt to move to its final destination before being dead-lettered

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Pipeline to process data before sending out to this output

systemFields.title: System fields
systemFields.description: Fields to automatically add to events, such as cribl_pipe. Supports wildcards.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

host.title: Host
host.description: The hostname of the destination.

mtu.title: Record size limit (bytes)
mtu.description: When protocol is UDP, specifies the maximum size of packets sent to the destination. Also known as the MTU for the network path to the destination system.

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: When protocol is TCP, specifies how often buffers should be flushed, resulting in records sent to the destination.

dnsResolvePeriodSec.title: DNS resolution period (sec)
dnsResolvePeriodSec.description: How often to resolve the destination hostname to an IP address. Ignored if the destination is an IP address. A value of 0 means every batch sent will incur a DNS lookup.

throttleRatePerSec.title: Throttling
throttleRatePerSec.description: Rate (in bytes per second) to throttle while writing to an output. Accepts values with multiple-byte units, such as KB, MB, and GB. (Example: 42 MB) Default value of 0 specifies no throttling.

connectionTimeout.title: Connection timeout
connectionTimeout.description: Amount of time (milliseconds) to wait for the connection to establish before retrying

writeTimeout.title: Write timeout
writeTimeout.description: Amount of time (milliseconds) to wait for a write to complete before assuming connection is dead

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

messageGroupId.title: Message Group ID
messageGroupId.description: This parameter applies only to FIFO queues. The tag that specifies that a message belongs to a specific message group. Messages that belong to the same message group are processed in a FIFO manner. Use event field __messageGroupId to override this value.

createQueue.title: Create Queue
createQueue.description: Create queue if it does not exist.

region.title: Region
region.description: AWS Region where the SQS queue is located. Required, unless the Queue entry is a URL or ARN that includes a Region.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Pipeline to process data before sending out to this output

systemFields.title: System fields
systemFields.description: Fields to automatically add to events, such as cribl_pipe. Supports wildcards. These fields are added as labels to generated logs.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

url.title: Loki URL
url.description: The endpoint to send logs to

message.title: Logs message field
message.description: Name of the event field that contains the message to send. If not specified, Stream sends a JSON representation of the whole event.

labels.title: Logs labels
labels.description: List of labels to send with logs. Labels define Loki streams, so use static labels to avoid proliferating label value combinations and streams. Can be merged and/or overridden by the event's __labels field. Example: '__labels: {host: "cribl.io", level: "error"}'

concurrency.title: Request concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of ongoing requests before blocking. Warning: Setting this value > 1 can cause Loki to complain about entries being delivered out of order.

maxPayloadSizeKB.title: Body size limit (KB)
maxPayloadSizeKB.description: Maximum size, in KB, of the request body. Warning: Setting this too low can increase the number of ongoing requests (depending on the value of 'Request concurrency'); this can cause Loki to complain about entries being delivered out of order.

maxPayloadEvents.title: Events-per-request limit
maxPayloadEvents.description: Maximum number of events to include in the request body. Defaults to 0 (unlimited). Warning: Setting this too low can increase the number of ongoing requests (depending on the value of 'Request concurrency'); this can cause Loki to complain about entries being delivered out of order.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate server certs
rejectUnauthorized.description:
Reject certificates not authorized by a CA in the CA certificate path or by another trusted CA (such as the system's). 
        Enabled by default. When this setting is also present in TLS Settings (Client Side), 
        that value will take precedence.

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout
timeoutSec.description: Amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a request to complete before canceling it

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Maximum time between requests. Small values can reduce the payload size below the configured 'Max record size' and 'Max events per request'. Warning: Setting this too low can increase the number of ongoing requests (depending on the value of 'Request concurrency'); this can cause Loki to complain about entries being delivered out of order.

extraHttpHeaders.title: Extra HTTP headers
extraHttpHeaders.description: Headers to add to all events

useRoundRobinDns.title: Round-robin DNS
useRoundRobinDns.description: Enable round-robin DNS lookup. When a DNS server returns multiple addresses, @{product} will cycle through them in the order returned. For optimal performance, consider enabling this setting for non-load balanced destinations.

safeHeaders.title: Safe headers
safeHeaders.description: List of headers that are safe to log in plain text

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

enableDynamicHeaders.title: Enable dynamic headers
enableDynamicHeaders.description: Add per-event HTTP headers from the __headers field to outgoing requests. Events with different headers are batched and sent separately.

totalMemoryLimitKB.title: Buffer memory limit (KB)
totalMemoryLimitKB.description: Maximum total size of the batches waiting to be sent. If left blank, defaults to 5 times the max body size (if set). If 0, no limit is enforced.

compress.title: Compress
compress.description: Compress the payload body before sending

token.title: Auth token
token.description: Bearer token to include in the authorization header. In Grafana Cloud, this is generally built by concatenating the username and the API key, separated by a colon. Example: <your-username>:<your-api-key>

textSecret.title: Auth token (text secret)
textSecret.description: Select or create a stored text secret

password.title: Password
password.description: Password (API key in Grafana Cloud domain) for authentication

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials secret
credentialsSecret.description: Select or create a secret that references your credentials

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

systemFields.title: System fields

environment.title: Environment

streamtags.title: Tags

messageField.title: Message field
messageField.description: Name of the event field that contains the message or attributes to send. If not specified, all of the event's non-internal fields will be sent as attributes.

excludeFields.title: Exclude fields
excludeFields.description: Fields to exclude from the event if the Message field is either unspecified or refers to an object. Ignored if the Message field is a string. If empty, we send all non-internal fields.

serverHostField.title: Server/host field
serverHostField.description: Name of the event field that contains the `serverHost` identifier. If not specified, defaults to `cribl_<outputId>`.

timestampField.title: Timestamp field
timestampField.description: Name of the event field that contains the timestamp. If not specified, defaults to `ts`, `_time`, or `Date.now()`, in that order.

defaultSeverity.title: Severity
defaultSeverity.description: Default value for event severity. If the `sev` or `__severity` fields are set on an event, the first one matching will override this value.

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

site.title: DataSet site
site.description: DataSet site to which events should be sent

concurrency.title: Request concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of ongoing requests before blocking

maxPayloadSizeKB.title: Body size limit (KB)
maxPayloadSizeKB.description: Maximum size, in KB, of the request body

maxPayloadEvents.title: Events-per-request limit
maxPayloadEvents.description: Maximum number of events to include in the request body. Default is 0 (unlimited).

compress.title: Compress
compress.description: Compress the payload body before sending

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate server certs
rejectUnauthorized.description:
Reject certificates not authorized by a CA in the CA certificate path or by another trusted CA (such as the system's). 
        Enabled by default. When this setting is also present in TLS Settings (Client Side), 
        that value will take precedence.

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout
timeoutSec.description: Amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a request to complete before canceling it

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Body size limit.

extraHttpHeaders.title: Extra HTTP headers
extraHttpHeaders.description: Headers to add to all events

useRoundRobinDns.title: Round-robin DNS
useRoundRobinDns.description: Enable round-robin DNS lookup. When a DNS server returns multiple addresses, @{product} will cycle through them in the order returned. For optimal performance, consider enabling this setting for non-load balanced destinations.

safeHeaders.title: Safe headers
safeHeaders.description: List of headers that are safe to log in plain text

totalMemoryLimitKB.title: Buffer memory limit (KB)
totalMemoryLimitKB.description: Maximum total size of the batches waiting to be sent. If left blank, defaults to 5 times the max body size (if set). If 0, no limit is enforced.

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: A 'Log Write Access' API key for the DataSet account

textSecret.title: API key (text secret)
textSecret.description: Select or create a stored text secret

systemFields.title: System fields
systemFields.description: Fields to automatically add to events, such as cribl_pipe. Supports wildcards.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

url.title: Next-Gen SIEM endpoint
url.description:
URL provided from a CrowdStrike data connector. 
Example: https://ingest.<region>.crowdstrike.com/api/ingest/hec/<connection-id>/v1/services/collector

concurrency.title: Request concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of ongoing requests before blocking

maxPayloadSizeKB.title: Body size limit (KB)
maxPayloadSizeKB.description: Maximum size, in KB, of the request body

maxPayloadEvents.title: Events-per-request limit
maxPayloadEvents.description: Maximum number of events to include in the request body. Default is 0 (unlimited).

compress.title: Compress
compress.description: Compress the payload body before sending

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate server certs
rejectUnauthorized.description:
Reject certificates not authorized by a CA in the CA certificate path or by another trusted CA (such as the system's). 
        Enabled by default. When this setting is also present in TLS Settings (Client Side), 
        that value will take precedence.

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout
timeoutSec.description: Amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a request to complete before canceling it

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Body size limit.

extraHttpHeaders.title: Extra HTTP headers
extraHttpHeaders.description: Headers to add to all events

useRoundRobinDns.title: Round-robin DNS
useRoundRobinDns.description: Enable round-robin DNS lookup. When a DNS server returns multiple addresses, @{product} will cycle through them in the order returned. For optimal performance, consider enabling this setting for non-load balanced destinations.

safeHeaders.title: Safe headers
safeHeaders.description: List of headers that are safe to log in plain text

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

textSecret.title: Next-Gen SIEM authentication token (text secret)
textSecret.description: Select or create a stored text secret

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Pipeline to process data before sending out to this output

systemFields.title: System fields
systemFields.description: Fields to automatically add to events, such as cribl_pipe. Supports wildcards.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: S3 service endpoint. If empty, defaults to the AWS Region-specific endpoint. Otherwise, it must point to S3-compatible endpoint.

enableAssumeRole.title: Enable for S3
enableAssumeRole.description: Use Assume Role credentials to access S3

assumeRoleArn.title: AssumeRole ARN
assumeRoleArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume

assumeRoleExternalId.title: External ID
assumeRoleExternalId.description: External ID to use when assuming role

durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
durationSeconds.description: Duration of the assumed role's session, in seconds. Minimum is 900 (15 minutes), default is 3600 (1 hour), and maximum is 43200 (12 hours).

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections
reuseConnections.description: Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

bucket.title: S3 bucket name
bucket.description: Name of the destination S3 bucket. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at initialization time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`

region.title: Region
region.description: Region where the S3 bucket is located

destPath.title: Key prefix
destPath.description: Prefix to prepend to files before uploading. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myKeyPrefix-${C.vars.myVar}`

maxConcurrentFileParts.title: Concurrent file parts upload limit
maxConcurrentFileParts.description: Maximum number of parts to upload in parallel per file. Minimum part size is 5MB.

verifyPermissions.title: Verify if bucket exists
verifyPermissions.description: Disable if you can access files within the bucket but not the bucket itself

maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.title: Staging file limit
maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.description: Maximum number of files that can be waiting for upload before backpressure is applied

stagePath.title: Staging location
stagePath.description: Filesystem location in which to buffer files, before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage.

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID
addIdToStagePath.description: Add the Output ID value to staging location

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories
removeEmptyDirs.description: Remove empty staging directories after moving files

baseFileName.title: File name prefix expression
baseFileName.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename prefix (can be constant)

fileNameSuffix.title: File name suffix expression
fileNameSuffix.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename suffix (can be constant).  The `__format` variable refers to the value of the `Data format` field (`json` or `raw`).  The `__compression` field refers to the kind of compression being used (`none` or `gzip`).

maxFileSizeMB.title: File size limit (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)
maxFileOpenTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

headerLine.title: Header line
headerLine.description: If set, this line will be written to the beginning of each output file

writeHighWaterMark.title: Writing high watermark (KB)
writeHighWaterMark.description: Buffer size used to write to a file

deadletterEnabled.title: Enable dead-lettering
deadletterEnabled.description: If a file fails to move to its final destination after the maximum number of retries, move it to a designated directory to prevent further errors

forceCloseOnShutdown.title: Force close on shutdown
forceCloseOnShutdown.description: Force all staged files to close during an orderly Node shutdown. This triggers immediate upload of in-progress data — regardless of idle time, file age, or size thresholds — to minimize data loss.

awsSecretKey.title: Secret key
awsSecretKey.description: Secret key. This value can be a constant or a JavaScript expression. Example: `${C.env.SOME_SECRET}`)

kmsKeyId.title: KMS key ID
kmsKeyId.description: ID or ARN of the KMS customer-managed key to use for encryption

partitioningFields.title: Partition by fields
partitioningFields.description: List of fields to partition the path by, in addition to time, which is included automatically. The effective partition will be YYYY/MM/DD/HH/<list/of/fields>.

awsApiKey.title: Access key
awsApiKey.description: This value can be a constant or a JavaScript expression (`${C.env.SOME_ACCESS_KEY}`)

awsSecret.title: Secret key pair
awsSecret.description: Select or create a stored secret that references your access key and secret key

automaticSchema.title: Automatic schema
automaticSchema.description: Automatically calculate the schema based on the events of each Parquet file generated

parquetSchema.title: Parquet schema
parquetSchema.description: To add a new schema, navigate to Processing > Knowledge > Parquet Schemas

parquetRowGroupLength.title: Group row limit
parquetRowGroupLength.description: The number of rows that every group will contain. The final group can contain a smaller number of rows.

parquetPageSize.title: Page size
parquetPageSize.description: Target memory size for page segments, such as 1MB or 128MB. Generally, lower values improve reading speed, while higher values improve compression.

shouldLogInvalidRows.title: Log invalid rows
shouldLogInvalidRows.description: Log up to 3 rows that @{product} skips due to data mismatch

keyValueMetadata.title: Metadata (optional)
keyValueMetadata.description: The metadata of files the Destination writes will include the properties you add here as key-value pairs. Useful for tagging. Examples: "key":"OCSF Event Class", "value":"9001"

enableStatistics.title: Write statistics
enableStatistics.description: Statistics profile an entire file in terms of minimum/maximum values within data, numbers of nulls, etc. You can use Parquet tools to view statistics.

enableWritePageIndex.title: Write page indexes
enableWritePageIndex.description: One page index contains statistics for one data page. Parquet readers use statistics to enable page skipping.

enablePageChecksum.title: Write page checksum
enablePageChecksum.description: Parquet tools can use the checksum of a Parquet page to verify data integrity

emptyDirCleanupSec.title: Staging cleanup period
emptyDirCleanupSec.description: How frequently, in seconds, to clean up empty directories

directoryBatchSize.title: Directory batch size
directoryBatchSize.description: Number of directories to process in each batch during cleanup of empty directories. Minimum is 10, maximum is 10000. Higher values may require more memory.

deadletterPath.title: Dead-letter location
deadletterPath.description: Storage location for files that fail to reach their final destination after maximum retries are exceeded

maxRetryNum.title: Retry limit
maxRetryNum.description: The maximum number of times a file will attempt to move to its final destination before being dead-lettered

environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: S3 service endpoint. If empty, defaults to the AWS Region-specific endpoint. Otherwise, it must point to S3-compatible endpoint.

enableAssumeRole.title: Enable for S3
enableAssumeRole.description: Use Assume Role credentials to access S3

assumeRoleArn.title: AssumeRole ARN
assumeRoleArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume

assumeRoleExternalId.title: External ID
assumeRoleExternalId.description: External ID to use when assuming role

durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
durationSeconds.description: Duration of the assumed role's session, in seconds. Minimum is 900 (15 minutes), default is 3600 (1 hour), and maximum is 43200 (12 hours).

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections
reuseConnections.description: Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

bucket.title: S3 bucket name
bucket.description: Name of the destination S3 bucket. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at initialization time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`

region.title: Region
region.description: Region where the S3 bucket is located

destPath.title: Lake dataset
destPath.description: Lake dataset to send the data to.

verifyPermissions.title: Verify if bucket exists
verifyPermissions.description: Disable if you can access files within the bucket but not the bucket itself

maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.title: Staging file limit
maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.description: Maximum number of files that can be waiting for upload before backpressure is applied

stagePath.title: Staging location
stagePath.description: Filesystem location in which to buffer files, before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage.

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID
addIdToStagePath.description: Add the Output ID value to staging location

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories
removeEmptyDirs.description: Remove empty staging directories after moving files

baseFileName.title: File name prefix expression
baseFileName.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename prefix (can be constant)

fileNameSuffix.title: File name suffix expression
fileNameSuffix.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename suffix (can be constant).  The `__format` variable refers to the value of the `Data format` field (`json` or `raw`).  The `__compression` field refers to the kind of compression being used (`none` or `gzip`).

maxFileSizeMB.title: File size limit (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)
maxFileOpenTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

headerLine.title: Header line
headerLine.description: If set, this line will be written to the beginning of each output file

writeHighWaterMark.title: Writing high watermark (KB)
writeHighWaterMark.description: Buffer size used to write to a file

deadletterEnabled.title: Enable dead-lettering
deadletterEnabled.description: If a file fails to move to its final destination after the maximum number of retries, move it to a designated directory to prevent further errors

forceCloseOnShutdown.title: Force close on shutdown
forceCloseOnShutdown.description: Force all staged files to close during an orderly Node shutdown. This triggers immediate upload of in-progress data — regardless of idle time, file age, or size thresholds — to minimize data loss.

awsSecretKey.title: Secret key
awsSecretKey.description: Secret key. This value can be a constant or a JavaScript expression. Example: `${C.env.SOME_SECRET}`)

kmsKeyId.title: KMS key ID
kmsKeyId.description: ID or ARN of the KMS customer-managed key to use for encryption

maxConcurrentFileParts.title: Concurrent file parts limit
maxConcurrentFileParts.description: Maximum number of parts to upload in parallel per file. Minimum part size is 5MB.

emptyDirCleanupSec.title: Staging cleanup period
emptyDirCleanupSec.description: How frequently, in seconds, to clean up empty directories

directoryBatchSize.title: Directory batch size
directoryBatchSize.description: Number of directories to process in each batch during cleanup of empty directories. Minimum is 10, maximum is 10000. Higher values may require more memory.

deadletterPath.title: Dead-letter location
deadletterPath.description: Storage location for files that fail to reach their final destination after maximum retries are exceeded

maxRetryNum.title: Retry limit
maxRetryNum.description: The maximum number of times a file will attempt to move to its final destination before being dead-lettered

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Pipeline to process data before sending out to this output

systemFields.title: System fields
systemFields.description: Fields to automatically add to events, such as cribl_pipe. Supports wildcards.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Optionally, enable this config only on a specified Git branch. If empty, will be enabled everywhere.

streamtags.title: Tags
streamtags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping in @{product}

url.title: URL
url.description: URL of the ClickHouse instance. Example: http://localhost:8123/

tableName.title: ClickHouse table
tableName.description: Name of the ClickHouse table where data will be inserted. Name can contain letters (A-Z, a-z), numbers (0-9), and the character "_", and must start with either a letter or the character "_".

format.title: Format
format.description: Data format to use when sending data to ClickHouse. Defaults to JSON Compact.

mappingType.title: Mapping type
mappingType.description: How event fields are mapped to ClickHouse columns

asyncInserts.title: Async inserts
asyncInserts.description: Collect data into batches for later processing on the ClickHouse server. Disable to write to a ClickHouse table immediately. Cribl sends the configured value with every insert (async_insert=1 or async_insert=0) so behavior is consistent across ClickHouse versions, including 26.3 LTS and later, where async inserts are enabled by default on the server.

concurrency.title: Request concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of ongoing requests before blocking

maxPayloadSizeKB.title: Body size limit (KB)
maxPayloadSizeKB.description: Maximum size, in KB, of the request body

maxPayloadEvents.title: Events-per-request limit
maxPayloadEvents.description: Maximum number of events to include in the request body. Default is 0 (unlimited).

compress.title: Compress
compress.description: Compress the payload body before sending

rejectUnauthorized.title: Validate server certs
rejectUnauthorized.description:
Reject certificates not authorized by a CA in the CA certificate path or by another trusted CA (such as the system's). 
        Enabled by default. When this setting is also present in TLS Settings (Client Side), 
        that value will take precedence.

timeoutSec.title: Request timeout
timeoutSec.description: Amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a request to complete before canceling it

flushPeriodSec.title: Flush period (sec)
flushPeriodSec.description: Maximum time between requests. Small values could cause the payload size to be smaller than the configured Body size limit.

extraHttpHeaders.title: Extra HTTP headers
extraHttpHeaders.description: Headers to add to all events

useRoundRobinDns.title: Round-robin DNS
useRoundRobinDns.description: Enable round-robin DNS lookup. When a DNS server returns multiple addresses, @{product} will cycle through them in the order returned. For optimal performance, consider enabling this setting for non-load balanced destinations.

safeHeaders.title: Safe headers
safeHeaders.description: List of headers that are safe to log in plain text

responseRetrySettings.title: Settings for failed HTTP requests
responseRetrySettings.description: Automatically retry after unsuccessful response status codes, such as 429 (Too Many Requests) or 503 (Service Unavailable)

responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.title: Honor Retry-After header
responseHonorRetryAfterHeader.description: Honor any Retry-After header that specifies a delay (in seconds) no longer than 180 seconds after the retry request. @{product} limits the delay to 180 seconds, even if the Retry-After header specifies a longer delay. When enabled, takes precedence over user-configured retry options. When disabled, all Retry-After headers are ignored.

dumpFormatErrorsToDisk.title: Log last schema mismatch
dumpFormatErrorsToDisk.description: Log the most recent event that fails to match the table schema

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials secret
credentialsSecret.description: Select or create a secret that references your credentials

waitForAsyncInserts.title: Wait for async inserts
waitForAsyncInserts.description: Cribl will wait for confirmation that data has been fully inserted into the ClickHouse database before proceeding. Disabling this option can increase throughput, but Cribl won't be able to verify data has been completely inserted.

excludeMappingFields.title: Exclude fields
excludeMappingFields.description: Fields to exclude from sending to ClickHouse

describeTable.title: Retrieve table columns
describeTable.description: Retrieves the table schema from ClickHouse and populates the Column Mapping table

columnName.title: Column name
columnName.description: Name of the column in ClickHouse that will store field value

columnType.title: Column type
columnType.description: Type of the column in the ClickHouse database

columnValueExpression.title: Column value
columnValueExpression.description: JavaScript expression to compute value to be inserted into ClickHouse table

pqStrictOrdering.title: Strict ordering
pqStrictOrdering.description: Use FIFO (first in, first out) processing. Disable to forward new events to receivers before queue is flushed.

pqRatePerSec.title: Drain rate limit (EPS)
pqRatePerSec.description: Throttling rate (in events per second) to impose while writing to Destinations from PQ. Defaults to 0, which disables throttling.

pqMaxBufferSize.title: Buffer size limit (events - deprecated)
pqMaxBufferSize.description: Maximum number of events to hold in memory before writing the events to disk. Deprecated and only supported in workers < v4.17.0. Use pqMaxBufferSizeBytes instead.

pqMaxBackpressureSec.title: Backpressure duration limit
pqMaxBackpressureSec.description: How long (in seconds) to wait for backpressure to resolve before engaging the queue

pqMaxFileSize.title: File size limit
pqMaxFileSize.description: The maximum size to store in each queue file before closing and optionally compressing (KB, MB, etc.)

pqMaxSize.title: Queue size limit
pqMaxSize.description: The maximum disk space that the queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc.

pqPath.title: Queue file path
pqPath.description: The location for the persistent queue files. To this field's value, the system will append: /<worker-id>/<output-id>.

pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.title: Buffer size limit (bytes)
pqMaxBufferSizeBytes.description: The maximum size to hold in memory before writing events to disk. Enter a numeral with units of KB, MB, etc. The minimum value is 64KB and the maximum value is 1MB.

verifyPermissions.title: Verify if bucket exists
verifyPermissions.description: Disable if you can access files within the bucket but not the bucket itself

maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.title: Staging file limit
maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.description: Maximum number of files that can be waiting for upload before backpressure is applied

stagePath.title: Staging location
stagePath.description: Filesystem location in which to buffer files, before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage.

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID
addIdToStagePath.description: Add the Output ID value to staging location

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories
removeEmptyDirs.description: Remove empty staging directories after moving files

partitionExpr.title: Partitioning expression
partitionExpr.description: JavaScript expression defining how files are partitioned and organized. Default is date-based. If blank, Stream will fall back to the event's __partition field value – if present – otherwise to each location's root directory.

baseFileName.title: File name prefix expression
baseFileName.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename prefix (can be constant)

fileNameSuffix.title: File name suffix expression
fileNameSuffix.description: JavaScript expression to define the output filename suffix (can be constant).  The `__format` variable refers to the value of the `Data format` field (`json` or `raw`).  The `__compression` field refers to the kind of compression being used (`none` or `gzip`).

maxFileSizeMB.title: File size limit (MB)
maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)
maxFileOpenTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

headerLine.title: Header line
headerLine.description: If set, this line will be written to the beginning of each output file

writeHighWaterMark.title: Writing high watermark (KB)
writeHighWaterMark.description: Buffer size used to write to a file

deadletterEnabled.title: Enable dead-lettering
deadletterEnabled.description: If a file fails to move to its final destination after the maximum number of retries, move it to a designated directory to prevent further errors

forceCloseOnShutdown.title: Force close on shutdown
forceCloseOnShutdown.description: Force all staged files to close during an orderly Node shutdown. This triggers immediate upload of in-progress data — regardless of idle time, file age, or size thresholds — to minimize data loss.

endpoint.title: Nutanix Objects endpoint
endpoint.description: Nutanix Objects S3-compatible endpoint URL (example: https://objects.nutanix.local)

awsSecret.title: Secret key pair
awsSecret.description: Select or create a stored secret that references your access key and secret key

automaticSchema.title: Automatic schema
automaticSchema.description: Automatically calculate the schema based on the events of each Parquet file generated

parquetSchema.title: Parquet schema
parquetSchema.description: To add a new schema, navigate to Processing > Knowledge > Parquet Schemas

parquetRowGroupLength.title: Group row limit
parquetRowGroupLength.description: The number of rows that every group will contain. The final group can contain a smaller number of rows.

parquetPageSize.title: Page size
parquetPageSize.description: Target memory size for page segments, such as 1MB or 128MB. Generally, lower values improve reading speed, while higher values improve compression.

shouldLogInvalidRows.title: Log invalid rows
shouldLogInvalidRows.description: Log up to 3 rows that @{product} skips due to data mismatch

keyValueMetadata.title: Metadata (optional)
keyValueMetadata.description: The metadata of files the Destination writes will include the properties you add here as key-value pairs. Useful for tagging. Examples: "key":"OCSF Event Class", "value":"9001"

enableStatistics.title: Write statistics
enableStatistics.description: Statistics profile an entire file in terms of minimum/maximum values within data, numbers of nulls, etc. You can use Parquet tools to view statistics.

enableWritePageIndex.title: Write page indexes
enableWritePageIndex.description: One page index contains statistics for one data page. Parquet readers use statistics to enable page skipping.

enablePageChecksum.title: Write page checksum
enablePageChecksum.description: Parquet tools can use the checksum of a Parquet page to verify data integrity

emptyDirCleanupSec.title: Staging cleanup period
emptyDirCleanupSec.description: How frequently, in seconds, to clean up empty directories

directoryBatchSize.title: Directory batch size
directoryBatchSize.description: Number of directories to process in each batch during cleanup of empty directories. Minimum is 10, maximum is 10000. Higher values may require more memory.

deadletterPath.title: Dead-letter location
deadletterPath.description: Storage location for files that fail to reach their final destination after maximum retries are exceeded

maxRetryNum.title: Retry limit
maxRetryNum.description: The maximum number of times a file will attempt to move to its final destination before being dead-lettered

reuseConnections.title: Reuse connections

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject unauthorized certificates
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates

bucket.title: Cloudian bucket name
bucket.description: Name of the destination Cloudian bucket. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at initialization time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myBucket-${C.vars.myVar}`

region.title: Region
region.description: Region where the Cloudian bucket is located

destPath.title: Key prefix
destPath.description: Prefix to prepend to files before uploading. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: `myKeyPrefix-${C.vars.myVar}`

maxConcurrentFileParts.title: Concurrent file parts upload limit
maxConcurrentFileParts.description: Maximum number of parts to upload in parallel per file. Minimum part size is 5MB.

verifyPermissions.title: Verify if bucket exists
verifyPermissions.description: Disable if you can access files within the bucket but not the bucket itself

maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.title: Staging file limit
maxClosingFilesToBackpressure.description: Maximum number of files that can be waiting for upload before backpressure is applied

stagePath.title: Staging location

addIdToStagePath.title: Add output ID

removeEmptyDirs.title: Remove empty staging directories

partitionExpr.title: Partitioning expression

baseFileName.title: File name prefix expression

maxFileOpenTimeSec.title: File open time limit (sec)

maxFileIdleTimeSec.title: Idle time limit (sec)
maxFileIdleTimeSec.description: Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location.

maxOpenFiles.title: Open file limit
maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of files to keep open concurrently. When exceeded, @{product} will close the oldest open files and move them to the final output location.

headerLine.title: Header line

writeHighWaterMark.title: Writing high watermark (KB)

maxFileSize.description: Maximum size of each persistent queue file before closing and optionally compressing. Value is a numeral and unit such as KB or MB. For s3 and nfs storage types, the value must not exceed 100MB (parsed as a byte-size string).

maxSize.description: Maximum disk space that the persistent queue can consume (as an average per Worker Process) before queueing stops. Value is a numeral and unit such as KB or MB. For s3 and nfs storage types, the value must not exceed 2000 times the effective maxFileSize (including defaults where maxFileSize is omitted), after both are parsed to bytes.

optimizeCost.description:
If true (default), the system batches S3 object uploads to reduce API call volume and rate-limit risk at scale. If false, the system uploads sealed queue files to S3 immediately, which results in greater API call volume and higher rate-limit risk.

If a node stops without graceful shutdown (for example, due to power loss), unreplicated data at risk is bounded by up to maxFileSize per PQ when false, and up to 2 × maxFileSize per PQ when true. Bounds apply per Worker Process, per PQ-enabled Source or Destination. A Worker Process crash without node loss does not lose events that were durably written to the local queue. These events are automatically recovered on restart.

rejectUnauthorized.description: If false, TLS certificate validation is disabled for the S3 endpoint (not recommended except for some S3-compatible endpoints).

post.description:
Check whether proxy declarations can be read from an App artifact before committing to a full install. Accepts the same source formats as POST /apps (staged upload filename, HTTPS URL, or git+ URL).

No installation is performed. Works for both new installs and upgrades, allowing callers to inspect proxy declarations and dangerous file types before committing to either operation.

For git+ sources, pass the same spec (branch, tag, or commit) you intend to use for the install or upgrade call to ensure the correct revision is checked out.

Returns the parsed contents of proxies.yml and a list of any files whose extensions match a blocklist of dangerous types (binaries, scripts, installers, etc.). The UI should surface dangerousFileTypes to the user before allowing the install or upgrade to proceed.

post.description:
Install a Pack.

To install an uploaded Pack, provide the source value from the PUT /packs response as the source parameter in the request body.

To install a Pack by importing from a URL, provide the direct URL location of the .crbl file for the Pack as the source parameter in the request body.

To install a Pack by importing from a Git repository, provide git+ as the source parameter in the request body.

If you do not include the source parameter in the request body, an empty Pack is created.

patch.description:
Upgrade the specified Pack.

If the Pack includes any user-modified versions of default Cribl Knowledge resources such as lookups, copy the modified files locally for safekeeping before upgrading the Pack. Copy the modified files back to the upgraded Pack after you install it with POST /packs to overwrite the default versions in the Pack.

After you upgrade the Pack, update any Routes, Pipelines, Sources, and Destinations that use the previous Pack version so that they reference the upgraded Pack.

parameters.description: Window end timestamp (in Unix time) in milliseconds. Must be later than the specified startTime.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the Dataset to get usage statistics for.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Window end timestamp (in Unix time) in milliseconds. Defaults to the current server time. Must not be older than 365 days.

parameters.name: timeWindow
parameters.description: Duration of the time window in milliseconds, counted back from the specified endTime. Defaults to 86400000 (24 hours). Must be a multiple of 1 minute and must not exceed 30 days.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Bucket width in milliseconds. Must be a multiple of 1 minute and must not exceed 24 hours.
